a: Matztziin tachtav, uvain aniyyim umekappelin otan meacharav! ibbaet ema: lichvodo hu daavad, veibbaet ema: kidvae leh lemibad la avad. kidamri inashe: lefum gamla shichna.

Tanya: amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: ere benechama, im lo reitiha shehayta melakketet seorim mibben talfe susim beakko. karati aleha mikra ze: "im lo tedi lach hayyafa bannashim tzei lach beikve hatztzon urei et gediyyotayich". al tikre "gediyyotayich", ella "geviyyotayich".

Amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hichnisa lo zahav — shamin oto, vahare hu keshovvyo. metivi: hazzahav hare hu kechelim. may lav: kechelim shel kesef, defachati! la, kechelim shel zahav, dela pachati. im ken, kechelav mibbee leh!

Veod, tanya: zahav hare hu kechelim. dinre zahav, hare hen kichsafim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bimkom shennahagu shello lefortan — shamin otan vahare hen beshovvyehen. rabban shimon ben gamliel aheyay? illema assefa, mikkelal detanna kamma savar afillu bimkom shennahagu shello lefortan? ha la nafki!
Ella lav aresha, vehachi kaamar: zahav hare hu kechelim, may kelim — kelim shel kesef. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hare hu kedinarin shel zahav, bimkom shennahagu shello lefortan!
La, leolam assefa, udenafki al yede haddechak. uveha kamippalgi, mar savar: kevan denafki, mashbechinan la, umar savar: kevan dela nafki ella al yede haddechak, la mashbechinan la.

Ibbaet ema: kulla rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, vechassore michassera, vehachi katane: zahav hare hu kechelim, dinre zahav hare hen kichsafim. bamme devarim amurim — bimkom shennahagu lefortan. aval bimkom shennahagu shello lefortan — shamin otam vahare hen beshovvyehen, divre rabban shimon ben gamliel. sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bimkom shennahagu shello lefortan, shamin otam vahare hen beshovvyehen.
Mikkol makom, "kechelav" mibbee leh! kashya. ibbaet ema: hacha bemay askinan — bedahava pericha. rav ashe amar: bemamla.
Amar rabbi yannay: besamim shel antochya — hare hen kichsafim. amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: gemallim shel arviyya — ishsha gova purna mehem.

Amar rav pappi: hane totve deve michse, ishsha gova purna mehem. veamar rav pappi: hane sakke derudeya veashle dekimchonya — ishsha gova purna mehen. amar rava, meresh hava amena: hane arneke demachoza — ishsha gova purna mehem. may tama? asmachtayyhu alayyhu. kevan dachazay deshakli lehu venafki, vechi mashkechi ara zavni behu, amena: asmachtayyhu aara hu.

Mishna hammassi et bitto setam — lo yifchot lah mechamishshim zuz. pasak lehachenisah arumma — lo yomar habbaal "kesheachnisenna leveti achassenna bichsuti", ella mechassah veodah bevet aviha. vechen hammassi et hayyetoma — lo yifchot lah mechamishshim zuz. im yesh bakkis — mefarnesin otah lefi kevodah.

Gemara amar abbaye: chamishshim zuze peshite. mimmay — middekatane sefa: im yesh bakkis — mefarnesin otah lefi kevodah, veamrinan may kis? amar rachava: arneki shel tzedaka. vei salka datin chamishshim zuze mammash, im yesh bakkis kamma yahavinan la? ella shema minna chamishshim zuze peshite.
Tanu rabbanan: yatom vitoma shebbau lehitparnes — mefarnesin et hayyetoma veachar kach mefarnesin et hayyatom, mippene shehaish darko lachzor al happetachim, veen ishsha darkah lachzor. yatom vitoma
b: Shebbau linnase — massiin et hayyetoma veachar kach massiin et hayyatom, mippene shebboshtah shel ishsha merubba mishshel ish.

Tanu rabbanan: yatom shebba lissa — sochrin lo bayit, umatztziin lo mitta vechol kele tashmisho, veachar kach massiin lo ishsha, shenneemar: "de machsoro asher yechsar lo". "de machsoro" — ze habbayit, "asher yechsar" — ze mitta veshulchan, "lo" — zo ishsha. vechen hu omer: "eese lo ezer kenegdo".

Tanu rabbanan: "de machsoro" — atta metzuvvev alav lefarneso, vei atta metzuvvev alav leashshero. "asher yechsar lo" — afillu sus lirkov alav veeved larutz lefanav. amru alav al hillel hazzaken shellakach leani ben tovim echad sus lirkov alav veeved larutz lefanav. paam achat lo matza eved larutz lefanav, veratz lefanav shelosha milin.

Tanu rabbanan: maase beanshe galil haelyon shellakchu leani ben tovim echad mitztzippori litra basar bechol yom. litra basar may revuta? amar rav huna: litra basar mishshel ofot. veibbaet ema belitra, basar mammash. rav ashe amar: hatam kefar katan haya, bechol yoma hava mafsedi chevta ammetuleteh.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi nechemya, amar leh: bamma atta soed? amar leh bevasar shamen veyayin yashan. retzoncha shettegalgel immi baadashim? gilgel immo baadashim vamet. amar: oy lo leze sheharago nechemya. adderabba, "oy lo linchemya sheharago leze" mibbee leh! ella: ihu hu dela ibbei leh lefannoke nafsheh kulle hay.

Hahu daata lekammeh derava, amar lo: bamma atta soed? amar lo: betarnegolet petuma veyayin yashan. amar leh: vela chayyshat leducheka detzibbura? amar leh: attu middidhu kaachelna? midderachmana kaachelna! detanena: "ene chol elecha yesabberu veatta noten lahem et ochlam beitto". "beittam" lo neemar, ella "beitto" — melammed shekkol echad veechad noten hakkadosh baruch hu parnasato beitto.
Addehachi, atay achateh derava dela chazya leh telesre shene, veatya leh tarnegolet petuma veyayin yashan. amar: may dekamma? amar leh: naaneti lecha, kum echol.

Tanu rabbanan: en lo veeno rotze lehitparnes — notnin lo leshum halevaa, vechozrin venotnin lo leshum mattana, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: notnin lo leshum mattana, vechozrin venotnin lo leshum halevaa. leshum mattana? ha la shakel! amar rava: liftoach lo leshum mattana.

Yesh lo veeno rotze lehitparnes — notnin lo leshum mattana, vechozrin venifrain mimmennu. chozrin venifrain hemennu, tu la shakel! amar rav pappa: leachar mita. rabbi shimon omer: yesh lo veeno rotze lehitparnes — en nizkakin lo. en lo veeno rotze lehitparnes — omrim lo: have mashkon vatol, kede shettazuach dato alav.

Tanu rabbanan: "haavet", ze sheen lo veeno rotze lehitparnes, shennotnim lo leshum halevaa, vechozrin venotnin lo leshum mattana. "taavitennu", ze sheyyesh lo veeno rotze lehitparnes, shennotnin lo leshum mattana, vechozrin venifrain hemennu leachar mita, divre rabbi yehuda.
Vachachamim omrim: yesh lo veeno rotze lehitparnes — en nizkakin lo. veella ma ani mekayyem "taavitennu"? dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.

Mar ukeva hava anya beshivavuteh dahava regil kol yoma deshade leh arbea zuze betzinnora dedashsha. (yom echad) [yoma chad] amar: ezil ichze man kaaved bi hahu tevuta. hahu yoma negaha leh lemar ukeva leve midresha, atya devethu bahadeh.

Kevan dechazyev deka matzle leh ledashsha, nefak batrayyhu. rehut mikkammeh, ayyli lehahu attuna dahava gerivfa nura, hava ka mikkalyayn kareh demar ukeva. amara leh devethu: shekol karaych otev akkaray. chalash dateh, amara leh: ana shechichana begavveh deveta umekarva ahanayayti.

Umay kulle hay? deamar mar zutera bar toviyya amar rav, veamri la amar rav huna bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida, veamri lah amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: noach lo laadam sheyyimsor atzmo letoch kivshan haesh, veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim. mena lan — mittamar, dichtiv: "hi mutzet".

Mar ukeva hava anya beshivavuteh dahava regil leshaddore leh arba mea zuze kol maale yoma dechippura. yoma chad shadderinhu nihaleh beyad bereh. ata amar leh: la tzerich. amar may chazet? chazay deka mezallefi leh yayin yashan. amar: mefannak kulle hay! ayyfinhu veshadderinhu nihaleh.

Ki ka nicha nafsheh, amar: ayyto li chushebnay ditzdaka. ashkach dahava ketiv beh shivat alfe dinare seyanke. amar: zavvday kallile veorcha rachikta. kam bazbezeh lefalgeh mamoneh. hechi avad hachi? vehaamar rabbi ilay, beusha hitkinu: hamevazbez — al yevazbez yoter mechomesh! hane mille mechayyim, shemma yered minnechasav. aval leachar mita let lan ba.
Rabbi abba hava tzayayr zuze besudareh, veshade leh laachoreh, umamtze nafsheh leve anye, umatzle eneh merammae.

Rabbi chanina hava hahu anya dahava regil leshaddore leh arbea zuze kol maale shabbeta. yoma chad shadderinhu nihaleh beyad devethu, atay amara leh: la tzerich. may chazet? shemai dahavo kaamri leh: bamma atta soed,

a: Bitle chesef o bitle zahav? amar: hayeynu deamar rabbi elazar: bou venachazik tova larammain, sheilmale hen, hayinu chotin bechol yom, shenneemar: "vekara alecha el Adonai vehaya vecha chet".

Vetane rabbi chiyyay bar rav middifti, rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: kol hammaalim enav min hatztzedaka — keillu oved avoda zara. ketiv hacha: "hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha veliyyaal vegomer", uchetiv hatam: "yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal". ma lehallan avoda zara, af kan avoda zara.

Tanu rabbanan: hamesamme et eno vehammatzbe et bitno, vehamekappeach et shoko — eno niftar min haolam ad sheyyavo lide chach. hamekabbel tzedaka veen tzarich lechach — sofo eno niftar min haolam ad sheyyavo lide chach.
Tenan hatam: en mechayyeyvin oto limkor et beto veet kele tashmisho. vela? vehatanya: haya mishtammesh bichle zahav — yishtammesh bichle chesef, bichle chesef — yishtammesh bichle nechoshet!

Amar rav zevid la kashya: ha — bemitta veshulechan, ha — bechosot ukearot. may shena kosot ukearot dela — deamar: meisi li. mitta veshulechan name, amar: la mekabbal illavay. amar rava bereh derabba: bemacharesha dechaspa.
Rav pappa amar, la kashya: kan — kodem sheyyavo lide gibbuy. kan — leachar sheyyavo lide gibbuy.
Mishna yetoma shehissiatta immah o acheha middatah, vechatvu lah bemea o bachamishshim zuz — yechola hi mishshettagdil lehotzi miyyadan ma sherauy lehinnaten lah.

Rabbi yehuda omer: im hissi et habbat harishona — yinnaten lashsheniyya kederech shennatan larishona. vachachamim omrim: peamim sheadam ani veheeshir, o ashir veheeni. ella shamin et hannechasim venotnin lah.

Gemara amar shemuel: lefarnasa — shamin baav. metivi: habbanot nizzonot umitparnesot minnichse avihen. ketzad? en omrim illu aviha kayyaym, kach vechach haya noten lah. ella shamin et hannechasim venotnin la. may lav: parnasat habbaal? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo, befarnasat atzmah.
Ha nizzonot umitparnesot katane, may lav: achat — parnasat habbaal, veachat — parnasat atzmah?! la, idi veidi befarnasat atzmah, vela kashya: ha — baachila uvishtiyya, veha — bilvusha vechissuya.

Tenan, vachachamim omrim: peamim sheadam ani veheeshir o ashir veheeni, ella shamin hannechasim venotnin lah. may "ani", umay "ashir"? i nema "ani" — ani binchasim, "ashir" — ashir binchasim, mikkelal detanna kamma savar afillu ashir veheeni kidmeikkara yahavinan la — ha let leh?

Ella lav "ani" — ani bedaat, "ashir" — ashir bedaat, vekatane: shamin et hannechasim venotnin lah, alma la azlinan batar umedana, uteyuveta dishmuel! hu deamar kerabbi yehuda. ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: im hissi bat harishona — yinnaten lashsheniyya kederech shennatan larishona.

Venema: halacha kerabbi yehuda! i amar halacha kerabbi yehuda, hava amena davka hissiah, degalli dateh. aval lo hissiah — la! ka mashma lan tama derabbi yehuda deazlinan batar umedana, la shena hissiah vela shena lo hissiah.
Vehay dekatane "hissiah" — lehodiacha kochan derabbanan, deaf al gav dehissiah vegalli dateh, la azlinan batar umedana.
Amar leh rava lerav chisda: darshinan mishshemach halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar leh: yehe raava kol ki hane mille mealleyayta tidreshu mishshemay.
Umi amar rava hachi? vehatanya, rabbi omer: bat hannizzonet min haachin — notelet issur nechasim. veamar rava: hilcheta kerabbi! la kashya ha — daamedneh, ha — dela amedneh.
Hachi name mistabbera, deamar rav adda bar ahava: maase venatan lah rabbi echad mishshenem asar bannechasim! kashyayn ahadade. ella lav shema minna: ha — daamedneh, ha — dela amedneh. shema minna.
Gufa, amar rabbi: bat hannizzonet min haachin notelet issur nechasim. amru lo lerabbi: lidvarecha, mi sheyyesh lo eser banot uven, en lo labben bimkom banot kelum!
Amar lahen, kach ani omer: rishona notelet issur nechasim, sheniyya — bamme sheshshiyyeyra, ushelishit — bamme sheshshiyyeyra. vechozrot vecholkot beshave.
b: Kol chada vachada denafsha shakla? hachi kaamar: im bau kullam lehinnase keachat cholkot beshave.
Mesayyay leh lerav matna. deamar rav matna: im bau lehinnase kullam keachat — notlot issur echad. issur echad salka datach? ella: notlot issur keechad.

Tanu rabbanan: habbanot ben bagru ad shello nisseu uven nisseu ad shello bagru — ibbedu mezonotehen velo ibbedu parnasatan, divre rabbi. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af ibbedu parnasatan. ketzad hen osot? sochrot lahen bealim, umotziin lahen parnasatan.

Amar rav nachman, amar li huna: hilcheta kerabbi. etiveh rava lerav nachman: yetoma shehissiatta immah o acheha middatah, vechatvu lah bemea o bachamishshim zuz, yechola hi mishshettagdil lehotzi miyyadam ma sherauy lehinnaten lah. tama diktanna, ha gedola, vittera!
La kashya: ha — demachay, ha — dela machay.
Hachi name mistabbera, deim ken, kashya derabbi adderabbi. detanya, rabbi omer: bat hannizzonet min haachin — notelet issur nechasim. nizzonet — in, sheenah nizzonet — la.
Ella lav shema minna: ha — demachay, ha — dela machay. shema minna.
Amar leh ravina lerava: amar lan rav adda bar ahava mishshemach: bagra — enah tzericha lemachot, nisset — enah tzericha lemachot. bagra venisset — tzericha lemachot.
Mi amar rava hachi? veha etiveh rava lerav nachman yetoma, veshanni leh: ha — demachay, ha — dela machay! la kashya: ha — deka mittazna minnayyhu. ha — dela ka mittazna minnayyhu.

Amar rav huna amar rabbi: parnasa enah kitnay ketubba. may "enah kitnay ketubba"? i nema: deillu parnasa — tarfa mimmeshabedi, utenay ketubba — la tarfa mimmeshabedi, may ka mashma lan? ha maasim bechol yom motziin lefarnasa, veen motziin limzonot.
Veella, deillu parnasa gavya name mimmittalteli, utenay ketubba mimmekarkee gavya, mimmittalteli la gavya.
Lerabbi idde veidde migba gavya, detanya: echad nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut veechad nechasim sheen lahen achrayut — motziin limzon haishsha velabbanot, divre rabbi.
Ella may "parnasa enah kitnay ketubba" — lechidtanya: haomer "al yizzonu benotav minnechasav" — en shomin lo. "al yitparnesu benotav minnechasav" — shomin lo, shehapparnasa enah kitnay ketubba.

a: Tela leh rav lerabbi bene chitte: haachin sheshshibedu, mahu? hava yatev rabbi chiyyay kammeh. amar leh: machru o mishkenu? amar leh: may nafka minna? ben machru ben shemmishkenu — motziin lefarnasa veen motziin limzonot!
Verav, i machru kamibbaya leh, nichtov leh machru? i mishkenu ka mibbaya leh, nichtov leh mishkenu?!
Rav tarvayyhu kamibbaya leh vesavar: i katevna leh machru, ha nicha i shalach li demotziin — kol shekken mishkenu. i shalach li en motziin — akkatti mishkenu kamibbaya li.
I katevna leh mishkenu, i shalach li deen motziin — kol shekken machru. i shalach li motziin, akkatti machru ka mibbaya li. echtov leh shibedu, demashma hachi umashma hachi.
Verabbi yochanan amar: echad ze veechad ze en motziin. ibbaya lehu: lerabbi yochanan, la shemia leh ha derabbi, vei shemia leh hava mekabbel leh, o dilma: shemia leh vela mekabbel leh?
Ta shema, deittemar: mi shemmet vehinniach shete banot uven, vekadma harishona venatla issur nechasim, velo hispika sheniyya ligbot ad shemmet habben,
Amar rabbi yochanan: sheniyya vittera. amar rabbi chanina, gedola mizzo amru: motziin lefarnasa veen motziin limzonot, veat amrat sheniyya vittera?!
Veim ita, nema leh: man amra? vedilma leolam la shemia leh, vechi shemia leh — kabbel, veshane hatam, deikka revavch beta.
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: ella meatta, ashkecha metzia bealma, deikka revavch beta — hachi name dela yahavinan la issur nechasim?! amar leh: ana revavch beta mehane nichse kaamena.

Amar ammemar: bat yoreshet havya. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: illu bae lesalloka bezuze, hachi name dela matze lesalloka? amar leh: in. i bae lesalloka bachada ara, hachi name dela matze mesallek la? amar leh: in.

Rav ashe amar: bat — baalat chov havya. veaf ammemar hadar beh, deamar rav minyome bereh derav nichumi: hava kaemna kammeh deammemar, vaatay hay itteta lekammeh, dahavat ka baaya issur nechasim. vachazeteh ledateh dei bae lesalloka bezuze hava mesallek la. deshami meache dahavo kaamri la: illu hava lan zuze, sallekna bezuze veishtik, vela amar lehu vela midde.
Vehasheta deamrat baalat chov havya: deabba o deache? lemay nafka minna? lemigbe levenonit shello bishvua, vezibburit bishvua.
May? ta shema deravina agbeya levarteh derav ashe mimmar bereh derav ashe benonit, veshello bishvua. mibbereh derav samma bereh derav ashe zibburit, bishvua.

Shelach leh rav nechemya bereh derav yosef lerabba bar rav huna zuta minnehardea: ki atya ha itteta lekammach, agbeya issur nichse afillu meitzterovla. amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav kahana, hava magbenan afillu meamla devete.

Shelach leh rav anan lerav huna: huna chavrin, shelam! ki atya ha itteta lekammach agbeya issur nichse. hava yatev rav sheshet kammeh, amar leh: zil ema leh: uveshamta yehe man dela amar leh: "anan anan! mimmekarkee o mimmittalteli?" uman yatev be marzecha beresha?"

Azal rav sheshet lekammeh derav anan, amar leh: mar rabba, verav huna rabbeh derabba, veshammote shammet man dela amar leh, vei lav deshammet, la hava kaamena: "anan, anan, mimmekarkee o mimmittalteli? uman yatev be marzecha beresha?"
Azal rav anan lekammeh demar ukeva, amar leh: chazi mar hechi shelach li rav huna "anan anan", veod "marzecha" dishlach li [la yadana] may nihu. amar leh: imma li izi
b: Gufa deovada hechi hava? amar leh: hachi vehachi hava maase. amar leh: gavra dela yada may nihu "marzecha", shalach leh lerav huna "huna chavrin"?! may "marzecha" — evel, dichtiv: "ko amar Adonai al tavo bet marzeach vegomer".

Amar rabbi avahu: minnayin laavel shemmesev barosh — shenneemar: "evchar darkam veeshev rosh veeshkon kemelech baggedud kaasher avelim yenachem". yenachem acherim mashma! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "yinnachem" ketiv.
Mar zutera amar, mehacha: "vesar mirzach seruchim". mar vazach — naase sar lisruchim.
Amar rava, hilcheta: mimmekarkee vela mimmittalteli, ben limzone, ben lichtubba, ben lefarnasa.

Mishna hammashlish maot levitto, vehi omeret: neeman bali alay — yaase hashshalish ma shehushelash beyado, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: vechi enah ella sade, vehi rotza lemochrah, hare hi mechura meachshav. bamme devarim amurim: bigdola. aval biktanna — en maase ketanna kelum.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammashlish maot lachatano likkach mehen sade levitto, vehi omeret: yinnatnu levali, min hannissuin — harshut beyadah, min haerusin — yaase hashshalish ma shehushelash beyado, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: haggedola, ben min hannissuin uven min haerusin — harshut beyadah. ketanna, ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin — yaase hashshalish ma shehushelash beyado.
May benayyhu? ilema ketanna min hannissuin ikka benayyhu, derabbi meir savar harshut beyadah, vaata rabbi yose lememar afillu min hannissuin name: gedola in, ketanna la.

Ema sefa: aval biktanna — en maase ketanna kelum. ha man katane la? illema rabbi yose, ha meresha shamat minna, deamar rabbi yose: vechi enah ella sade vehi rotza lemochrah, hare hi mechura meachshav. gedola devat zevine — in, ketanna delav bat zevine hi — la!

Ella rabbi meir hi, vechassore michassera vehachi katane: yaase hashshalish ma shehushelash beyado. bamme devarim amurim — min haerusin, aval min hannissuin — harshut beyadah. bamme devarim amurim — bigdola, aval biktanna — en maase ketanna kelum. ella gedola min haerusin ikka benayyhu.
Ittemar, rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose, rava amar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi meir.
Ilfa tela nafsheh beiskarya demachuta, amar: ikka deate deamar li milleta deve rabbi chiyyay verabbi oshaya vela pashetna leh mimmatnitin, nafelna meiskarya vetavana.

Ata hahu sava tena leh: haomer "tenu shekel levanay beshabbat", ureuyin litten lahem sela — notnin lahem sela. veim amar "al tittenu lahem ella shekel" — en notnin lahem ella shekel. veim amar "im metu yirshu acherim tachtehem", ben sheamar "tenu", ben sheamar "al tittenu" — en notnim lahem ella shekel.
Amar leh: ha manni?

a: Rabbi meir hi, deamar: mitzva lekayyem divre hammet.

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva, hilcheta: ben sheamar "tenu" uven sheamar "al tittenu" — notnin lahem kol tzorkam. ha kayyma lan halacha kerabbi meir, deamar: mitzva lekayyem divre hammet? hane mille bemille achranyata, aval beha menach nicha leh, veha deamar hachi — lezarozinhu hu daata.
Tenan hatam: happaotot mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mecher bemittaltelim.
Amar rafram: lo shanu ella sheen sham appotroppos, aval yesh sham appotroppos — en mikkachan mikkach, veen mimkaran mecher.

Mimmay? middekatane: en maase ketanna kelum. vedilma hecha deikka shalish shane? im ken litne "aval biktanna, yaase shalish ma shehushelash beyado". may "en maase ketanna kelum"? shema minna afillu bealma.
Hadaran alach metziat haishsha
Hammaddir et ishto millehanot lo, ad sheloshim yom yaamid parnas. yater mikken — yotzi veyitten ketubba.
Rabbi yehuda omer: beyisrael, chodesh echad — yekayyem, ushenayim — yotzi veyitten ketubba. bechohen, shenayim — yekayyem, ushelosha — yotzi veyitten ketubba.

Hammaddir et ishto shello titom echad mikkol happerot — yotzi veyitten ketubba, rabbi yehuda omer: beyisrael, yom echad — yekayyem, shenayim — yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvechohen, shenayim — yekayyem, shelosha — yotzi veyitten ketubba.
Hammaddir et ishto shello titkashshet beechad mikkol hamminin — yotzi veyitten ketubba. rabbi yose omer: baaniyyut — shello natan kitzva, uvaashirut — sheloshim yom.
Gemara vechevan dimshuebad lah hechi matze maddir la? kol keminneh demafka la leshibuda?
Vehatnan: "kuvnnam sheeni osa leficha" — eno tzarich lehafer. alma kevan dimshabeda leh, lav kol kemina demafka leh leshibudeh. hacha name: kevan dimshuebad la, lav kol keminneh demafka la leshibuda!
Ella: mittoch sheyyachol lomar lah "tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich",
b: Naasa keomer lah "tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich". veim ita leha derav huna amar rav, deamar rav huna amar rav: yechola ishsha shettomar levalah "eni nizzonet veeni osa", "kunnam sheani osa leficha", ammay eno tzarich lehafer? lema: mittoch sheyyechola lomar "eni nizzonet veeni osa", naase kemi sheomeret lo: "eni nizzonet veeni osa".
Ella, la tema "naase", ella beomer lah: "tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich".
I hachi parnas lema la? bidla safka: i bidla safka — hadar kusheyayn leducheteh? amar rav ashe: bemaspeket lidvarim gedolim, veenah maspeket lidvarim ketannim.

Hane devarim ketannim, hechi dame? i dirgila behu — ha regila behu! vei la regila behu — parnas lema la? la tzericha: dirgila bevet nasha, veka megalgela bahadeh, deamra leh: ad haiddana dela addartan — galgelna bahadach, hasheta deaddartan — la matzena deeygalgel bahadach.
Umay shena ad sheloshim yom? ad sheloshim yom lo shami ba inashe vela zila ba milleta, tefe — shami ba inashe vezila ba milleta.
Ibbaet ema shehiddirah keshehi arusa, arusa mi it la mezone? shehiggia zeman velo nisseu. ditnan: higgia zeman velo nisseu — ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma.
Umay shena ad sheloshim yom? ad sheloshim yom aved shaliach shelichuteh, tefe — la aved shaliach shelichuteh.
Veibbaet ema shehiddirah keshehi arusa venisset, nisset — ha sevara vekabbila! deamra: kisvura ani sheani yechola lekabbel, achshav en ani yechola lekabbel.
Emar deamrinan hachi gabbe mumin, leinyan mezone mi amrinan hachi? ella mechavvavrta kidshanninan meikkara.
Ad sheloshim yom yaamid parnas. ufarnas lav shelichuteh ka aved? amar rav huna, beomer: "kol hazzan eno mafsid".
Vechi amar hachi lav shelichuteh kaaved? vehatnan: mi shehaya mushelach bevor, veamar: "kol hashshomea kolo yichtov get leishto" — hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam kaamar "yichtov", hacha mi kaamar "yazun"? "kol hazzan" kaamar!
Veha amar rabbi amme: bidleka hittiru lomar: "kol hamechabbe eno mafsid". bidleka lemaote may? lav lemaote ki hay gavvna?! la, lemaote shear issurim deshabbat.

Metiv rabba: hammuddar hanaa mechavero, veen lo ma yochal — yelech etzel chenvani haragil etzlo, veyomar lo: "ish peloni muddar hanaa mimmenni, veeni yodea ma eese lo". hu noten lo, uva venotel mizze. hachi hu dishre, aval "kol hazzan eno mafsid" — la!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya "kol hazzan eno mafsid" — dilalma kaamar, aval hay, kevan deragil etzlo vekaazel kaamar leh, keman deamar leh zil, "hav leh at" dame — ka mashma lan.

Gufa: hammuddar hanaa mechavero veen lo ma yochal, holech etzel chenvani haragil etzlo, veomer lo: "ish peloni muddar hanaa mimmenni, veeni yodea ma eese lo". hu noten lo, uva venotel mizze. beto livnot, ugedero ligdor, vesadehu liktzor — holech etzel poalin hargilin etzlo, veomer lahen: "ish peloni muddar hanaa mimmenni veeni yodea ma eese lo". hen osin immo, uvain venotlim secharan mizze.

Hayu mehallechin badderech, veen immo ma yochal — noten leacher leshum mattana, vehalla notel veochel, umuttar. veim en sham acher — manniach al gabbe hassela o al gabbe haggader, veomer: "hare hen mufekarin lechol mi sheyyachpotz", vehalla notel veochel, umuttar. verabbi yose oser. amar rava: may tama derabbi yose — gezera mishshum

a: Maase devet choron.
Rabbi yehuda omer: beyisrael chodesh echad vechulei. hayeynu tanna kamma? amar abbaye: kohenet ata leashmoinan. rava amar: chodesh male vechodesh chaser ikka benayyhu.
Amar rav: lo shanu ella bimfaresh, aval bistam — yotzi lealtar veyitten ketubba. ushemuel amar: afillu bistam lo yotzi, shemma yimtza petach lenidro.

Veha ippeligu bay chada zimna, ditnan: hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta, bet shammay omrim: shete shabbatot. — uvet hillel omrim: shabbat achat. veamar rav: machloket bimfaresh, aval bistam — yotzi lealtar veyitten ketubba. ushemuel amar: afillu bistam name lo yotzi, shemma yimtza petach lenidro.

Tzericha, dei ittemar behahi: behahi kaamar rav — mishshum dela efshar befarnas, aval beha, deefshar befarnas — ema mode leh lishmuel. vei ittemar beha: beha kaamar shemuel — mishshum deefshar befarnas, aval behahi, ema mode leh lerav — tzericha.
Tenan: hammaddir et ishto shello titom echad mikkol happerot — yotzi veyitten ketubba. bishlama lerav: kan bistam, kan bimfaresh. ella lishmuel kashya!
Hacha bemay askinan — kegon shennadra hi, vekiyyem lah ihu. vekasavar rabbi meir, hu noten etzba ben shinneha.

Vesavar rabbi meir hu noten etzba ben shinneha? vehatanya: haishsha shennadra benazir, veshama balah velo hefer lah, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim: hi natna etzba ben shinneha, lefichach im ratza habbaal lehafer — yafer. veim amar i efshi beishsha nadranit — tetze shello bichtubba.

Rabbi yose verabbi elazar omrim: hu noten etzba ben shinneha, lefichach im ratza habbaal lehafer — yafer. veim amar: i efshi beishsha nadranit — yotzi veyitten ketubba! efoch, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim: hu noten, rabbi yose verabbi elazar omrim: hi natna.
Vesavar rabbi yose hi natna? vehatnan: rabbi yose omer: baaniyyut shello natan kitzva!
Ema, rabbi meir verabbi yose omrim: hu noten, rabbi yehuda verabbi elazar omrim: hi natna. vesavar rabbi yehuda hi natna? vehatnan, rabbi yehuda omer: beyisrael yom echad — yekayyem!

Ema, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda verabbi yose omrim: hu noten, verabbi elazar omer: hi natna. veim timtza lomar zuge zuge katane, ema, rabbi meir verabbi elazar omrim: hi natna, rabbi yehuda verabbi yose omrim: hu noten. veha setama dela kerabbi meir.

Vesavar rabbi yose baaniyyut shello natan kitzva, alma baal matze mefar? ureminhu: ellu devarim shehabbaal mefer: devarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh, "im erchatz", "im lo erchatz". "im etkashshet", "im lo etkashshet". amar rabbi yose: en ellu nidre innuy nefesh, veellu hen nidre innuy nefesh: "shello ochal basar", veshello eshte yayin", veshello etkashshet
b: Bevigde tzivonin"! hacha bemay askinan — bidvarim shebbeno levenah.

Hanicha leman deamar devarim shebbeno levenah habbaal mefer. ella leman deamar en habbaal mefer, may ikka lememar? deittemar: devarim shebbeno levenah, rav huna amar: habbaal mefer, rav adda bar ahava amar: en habbaal mefer, shello matzinu shual shemmet baafar pir.
Ella hacha bemay askinan — kegon ditla[ta]nehu lekishshuteha betashmish hammitta, deamra: "yeaser hanaat tashmishcha alay im etkashshet", kidamar rav kahana.
Deamar rav kahana: "hanaat tashmishi alecha" — kofah umeshammashto. "hanaat tashmishcha alay" — yafer, lefi sheen maachilin laadam davar haasur lo.
Velo titkashshet velo teaser! im ken karu la "menuvvevlet".

Vetitkashshet veteaser, i levet shammay shete shabbatot, i levet hillel shabbat achat! hane mille hecha deaddera ihu, desavra: mirtach ratach illavay vehasheta motev dateh. aval hacha, dindara ihi veshatek la, savra middeishtik — misna hu desane li.

Rabbi yose omer: baaniyyut shello natan kitzva. vechamma kitzva? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shenem asar chodesh. rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: eser shanim. rav chisda amar avimi: regel, shekken benot yisrael mitkashshetot baregel.
Uvaashirut sheloshim yom. may shena sheloshim yom? amar abbaye: shekken ishsha chashuva nehenet mereach kishshuteha sheloshim yom.

Mishna hammaddir et ishto shello telech levet aviha, bizman shehu immah bair — chodesh echad yekayyem, shenayim yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvizman shehu beir acheret — regel echad yekayyem, shelosha — yotzi veyitten ketubba.
Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levet haevel o levet hammishte — yotzi veyitten ketubba, mippene shennoel befaneha. veim haya toen mishshum davar acher — rashshay.
Amar lah: "al menat shettomri lifloni ma sheamarta li", o: "ma sheamarti lach", o shettehe memallea umeara laashpa — yotzi veyitten ketubba.
Gemara ha gufa kashya: amrat regel echad yekayyem. ha shenayim — yotzi veyitten ketubba. ema sefa: shelosha — yotzi veyitten ketubba. ha shenayim — yekayyem.
Amar abbaye: sefa atan lechohenet, verabbi yehuda hi. rabba bar ulla amar, la kashya: kan birdufa, kan besheenah redufa.
"Az hayiti veenav kemotzet shalom", amar rabbi yochanan: kechalla shennimtzet shelema bevet chamiha, uredufa lelech ulehaggid shivchah bevet aviha.
"Vehaya bayyom hahu neum Adonai tikrei ishi velo tikrei li od bali", amar rabbi yochanan: kechalla bevet chamiha, velo kechalla bevet aviha.
Hammaddir et ishto vechulei. bishlama levet hammishte

a: Ikka noel befaneha, ella levet haevel may noel befaneha ikka? tana: lemachar hi meta veen kol beriyya sofdah. veikka deamri: en kol beriyya sofnah.

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: may dichtiv "tov lalechet el bet evel millechet el bet mishte baasher hu sof kol haadam vehachay yitten el libbo", may "vehachay yitten el libbo"? devarim shel mita: d[yi]sepod — yispeduneh, d[yi]kebar — yikberuneh, didal — yedalluneh, di[10]lavvey — yelauoneh, d[yi]teon — yitanuneh.

Veim haya toen mishshum davar acher — rashshay. may "davar acher"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mishshum bene adam perutzin shemmetzuyin sham. amar rav ashe: la amaran ella deittachzak, aval la ittachzak — lo kol keminneh.
Veim amar lah al menat shettomri. vetema? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: devarim shel kalon.
O shettehe memallea umeara leashpa. vetibed! amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shettemalle venofetzet. bematnita tanna: shettemalle asara kadde mayim uteare leashpa.
Bishlama lishmuel — mishshum hachi yotzi veyitten ketubba. ella lematnita may nafka la minna? tibed! amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: mippene shennirita keshote.
Amar rav kahana: hammaddir et ishto shello tishal veshello tashil nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur — yotzi veyitten ketubba. shemmassiah shem ra bishchenoteha.

Tanya name hachi: hammaddir et ishto shello tishal veshello tashil nafa uchevara rechayim vetannur — yotzi veyitten ketubba, mippene shemmassiah shem ra bishchenoteha. vechen hi shennadra shello tishal veshello tashil nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur, veshello teerog begadim naim levanav — tetze shello bichtubba, mippene shemmassiato shem ra bishchenav.
Mishna veellu yotzot shello bichtubba — haoveret al dat moshe vihudit. veezo hi dat moshe? maachilato sheeno meussar, umeshammashto nidda, velo kotza lah challa, venoderet veenah mekayyemet.

Veezohi dat yehudit? yotza veroshah parua, vetove beshuk, umedabberet im kol adam. abba shaul omer: af hamekallelet yoldav befanav. rabbi tarfon omer: af hakkolanit. veezohi kolanit? lichshehi medabberet betoch betah ushecheneha shomin kolah.
Gemara maachilato sheeno meussar, hechi dame? i deyada — nifrosh. i dela yada — mena yada? la tzericha, deamra leh "peloni kohen tikken li et hakkeri", veazel shayyleh, veishtechach shikra.

Umeshammashto nidda. hechi dame? i deyada bah — nifrosh, i dela yada — nismoch illava. deamar rav chinnana bar kahana amar shemuel: minnayin lenidda shessoferet leatzmah — shenneemar: "vesafra lah shivat yamim", "lah" — leatzmah!

La tzericha, deamra leh: peloni chacham tiher li et haddam, vaazal shayyleh, veishtechach shikra. veibbaet ema kidrav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: huchezka nidda bishchenoteha — balah loke aleha mishshum nidda.
Velo kotza lah challa. hechi dame? i deyada — nifrosh, i dela yada — mena yada? la tzericha, deamra leh: peloni gabbal tikken li et haissa, veazel shayyleh, veishtechach shikra.

Venoderet veenah mekayyemet. deamar mar: baavon nedarim banim metim, shenneemar: "al titten et picha lachati et besarecha vegomer". veezo hen maase yadav shel adam — heve omer banav uvenotav. rav nachman amar mehacha: "lashshav hikketi et benechem", "lashshav" — al iske shav.

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: kol hayyodea beishto shennoderet veenah mekayyemet — yachzor veyaddirenna. yaddirenna?! bemay metakken la? ella: yachzor veyaknitenna, kede shettiddor befanav veyafer lah. amru lo: en adam dar im nachash bichfifa.
Tanya, haya rabbi yehuda omer: kol hayyodea beishto sheenah kotze lo challa — yachzor veyafrish achareha. amru lo: en adam dar im nachash bichfifa.
Man dematne la aha, kol shekken ahach. aval man dematne ahach, aval ha — zimnin demikkere veachel.
Veezohi dat yehudit? yotza veroshah parua. roshah parua deorayyta hi, dichtiv: "ufara et rosh haishsha", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: azhara livnot yisrael shello yetzu bifrua rosh! deorayyta —
b: Kaltah shappir dame, dat yehudit — afillu kaltah name asur.

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: kaltah, en bah mishshum perua rosh. have ba rabbi zera: hecha? illema beshuk — dat yehudit hi! veella bechatzer — im ken lo hinnachta bat leavraham avinu sheyyoshevet tachat balah! amar abbaye veittema rav kahana: mechatzer lechatzer vederech mavoy.

Vetove bashshok. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bemara zerooteha livne adam. rav chisda amar avimi: betove verad keneged paneha, umedabberet im kol adam. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bimsacheket im bachurim.

Amar rabba bar bar chana: zimna chada hava kaazelna batreh derav ukeva, chaziteh lehahi arvaya dahava yatva ka shadya pilka, vetove verad keneged paneha. kevan dachazetinan, pesaykteh lefilka shedeteh. amara li: ulam, hav li pelech. amar ba rav ukeva milleta. may amar bah? ravina amar: "tova bashshuk" amar ba. rabbanan amri: "medabberet im kol adam" amar bah.

Abba shaul omer: af hamekallelet yoldav befanav. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bimkallelet yolydav bifne molaydav. vesimanaych: "efrayim umenashshe kiruven veshimon yihyu li". amar rabba: deamra leh "nechleh arya lesava beappe bereh".
Rabbi tarfon omer: af hakkolanit. may "kolanit"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bemashmaat kolah al iske tashmish. bematnita tana: bimshammeshet bechatzer zo venishma kolah bechatzer acheret.
Venitneyay gabbe mumin bematnitin! ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara.
Mishna hammikdash et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim, venimtzeu aleha nedarim — enah mekuddeshet, kenasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim — tetze shello bichtubba.
Al menat sheen bah mumin venimtzeu bah mumin — enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu bah mumin — tetze shello bichtubba. kol hammumin happoslin bakkohanim — poslin benashim.
Gemara utenan name gabbe kiddushin ki hay gavvna! hacha — ketubbot itztericha leh, tanna kiddushin attu ketubbot. hatam — kiddushin itztericha leh, tena ketubbot attu kiddushin.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: beellu nedarim amru — shello tochal basar, veshello tishte yayin, veshello titkashshet bevigde tzivonim. tanya name hachi: beellu nedarim amru — devarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh: shello tochal basar, veshello tishte yayin, veshello titkashshet bevigde tzivonin.
Have ba rav pappa: aheyay? illema aresha: kevan deka kafed — afillu kol mille name! ella assefa.
Rav ashe amar: leolam aresha, umiddi dekafdi ba inashe — hava kefideh kefida. midde dela kafdi ba inashe — la have kefideh kefida.
Ittemar: kiddesha al tenay uchenasah setam, rav amar: tzericha hemennu get. ushemuel amar: enah tzericha hemennu get. amar abbaye:

a: La tema tameh derav kevan shekkenasah setam achole achaleh litnaeh, ella tama derav: lefi sheen adam ose beilato beilat zenut.
Ha peligi va chada zimna, deittemar: ketanna shello meana, vehigdila, amda venisset — rav amar: en tzericha get mishsheni.
Ushemuel amar: tzericha get mishsheni.
Tzericha, dei ittemar behahi: behahi kaamar rav mishshum delekka tenaa, aval beha deikka tenaa — ema mode leh lishmuel.
Vei ittemar beha: beha kaamar shemuel, aval behach — ema mode leh lerav, tzericha.
Tenan: kenasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim — tetze shello bichtubba. ketubba hu dela baaya, ha gitta baaya. may lav, kiddesha al tenay uchenasah setam, teyuveta dishmuel!
b: La, kiddesha setam, uchenasah setam.

Aval, kiddesha al tenay uchenasah setam — hachi name dela baaya gitta? addetane hamekaddesh et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim venimtzeu aleha nedarim enah mekuddeshet, litne: kenasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim — enah mekuddeshet, vechol shekken ha.
Hachi name kaamar: hamekaddesh et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim uchenasah setam, venimtzeu aleha nedarim — enah mekuddeshet. kiddesha setam uchenasah setam — tetze shello bichtubba.
Ketubba hu dela baaya, ha gitta — baaya. umay shena ketubba dela baaya — deamar: i efshi beishsha nadranit, i hachi get name la tibbee!
Amar rabba: tzericha get middivrehem. vechen amar rav chisda: tzericha get middivrehem. rava amar: tanna sappoke mesappeka leh, gabbe mamona lekulla, gabbe issura lechumera.
Amar rabba: machloket betaut shete nashim. aval betaut ishsha achat — divre hakkol en tzericha hemennu get.
Amar (leh) abbaye: veha matnitin detaut ishsha achat hi, vekamotvinan teyuveta minnay!
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rabba: machloket betaut ishsha achat keen shete nashim. aval betaut ishsha achat geredta — divre hakkol enah tzericha hemennu get.

Etiveh abbaye: kiddeshah betaut, ufachot mishshave peruta, vechen katan shekkiddesh, af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar mikken — enah mekuddeshet, shemmechamat kiddushin harishonim shalach. veim baalu — kanu. rabbi shimon ben yehuda mishshum rabbi yishmael amar: im baalu lo kanu.
Veha hacha detaut ishsha achat hi, ufeligi. may lav taut nedarim?

La, taut pachot mishshave peruta. pachot mishshave peruta behedya katane la: kiddeshah betaut ufachot mishshave peruta! paroshe ka mefaresh: kiddeshah betaut ketzad? kegon shekkiddeshah befachot mishshave peruta.

Bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: adam yodea sheen kiddushin tofsin befachot mishshave peruta, vegamar uvaal leshem kiddushin. umar savar: en adam yodea sheen kiddushin tofsin befachot mishshave peruta, vechi ka vaal, addata dekiddushin harishonim baal.

Etiveh: "hareni boalich al menat sheyyirtze abba", af al pi shello ratza haav — mekuddeshet. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: ratza haav mekuddeshet, lo ratza haav enah mekuddeshet. veha hacha, dechi taut ishsha achat dame, ufeligi!
Hatam beha kamippalgi, mar savar "al menat sheyyirtze haav" — al menat sheyyishtok haav, veha shatek leh. umar savar "al menat sheyyomar abba 'hen", veha la amar abba 'hen.
Etiveh: modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer biktanna shehissiah aviha, venitgarsha vehi yetoma bechayye haav, vehechzirah — shecholetzet velo mityabbemet,
Mippene sheggerusheha gerushin gemurin, veen chazaratah chazara gemura.

Bamme devarim amurim — sheggershah keshehi ketanna, vehechzirah keshehi ketanna. aval gershah keshehi ketanna vehechzirah keshehi gedola, o shehechzirah keshehi ketanna vegadla etzlo vamet — o choletzet o mityabbemet.

a: Mishshum rabbi eliezer amru: choletzet velo mityaybemet. veha hacha, dichtaut ishsha achat dame, ufeligi!

Hatam name beha kamippalgi, mar savar: adam yodea sheen kiddushe ketanna kelum, vegamar uvaal leshem kiddushin, umar savar: en adam yodea sheen kiddushe ketanna kelum, vechi ka vaal — addata dekiddushin harishonim ka vaal.

Ittemar name, amar rav acha bar yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: hamekaddesh al tenay uvaal — [divre hakkol] enah tzericha hemennu get. etiveh rav acha bereh derav ika bar achateh: chalitza muteet keshera. ezo hi chalitza muteet? amar resh lakish: kol sheomer lo "chalotz lah, uvechach atta konsah".

Amar rabbi yochanan, ani shone: ben shennitkavvevn hu velo nitkavvevna hi, ben shennitkavvevna hi velo nitkavvevn hu chalitzatah pesula, ad sheyyitkavvevnu shenehem. veat amrat chalitzatah keshera? ella amar rabbi yochanan: kol sheomer lo "chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz".
Alma kevan daavad maase — achole achaleh litnaeh. hacha name, kevan dival — achole achaleh litnaeh!
Amar leh bar be rav: shappir ka amrat? mikkede kol tenay mehecha gamrinan — mittenay bene gad uvene reuven,
Tenaa deefshar lekayyomeh al yede shaliach, ki hatam — have tenaeh tenaa. dela efshar lekayyomeh al yede shaliach, ki hatam — la have tenaa.
Veha bia, dela efshar lekayyomay al yede shaliach ki hatam, veka have tenaa!
Hatam, mishshum deittakkush havayot lahadade.
Amar rav ulla bar abba amar ulla amar rabbi elazar: hamekaddesh bemilva uvaal, al tenay uvaal, befachot mishshave peruta uvaal — divre hakkol tzericha hemennu get.
Amar rav yosef bar abba amar rabbi menachem amar rabbi amme: hamekaddesh befachot mishshave peruta uvaal, tzericha hemennu get. beha hu dela tae, aval behanach tae.
Amar rav kahana mishshemeh deulla: hamekaddesh al tenay uvaal — tzericha hemennu get. ze haya maase, velo haya koach bachachamim lehotziah belo get.

Leappoke mehay tanna. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi yishmael: "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura. ha nitpasa — mutteret. veyesh lecha acheret sheaf al pi shello nitpasa, mutteret. veezo zo? shekkiddusheha kiddushe taut, sheafillu benah murekav al ketefah,
b: Memaenet veholechet lah.

Tanu rabbanan: halcha etzel chacham vehittirah — mekuddeshet. etzel rofe verippe otah — enah mekuddeshet. ma ben chacham lerofe? chacham oker et hanneder meikkaro, verofe eno merappe ella mikkan ulehabba.

Vehatanya: etzel chacham vehittirah, etzel rofe verippe otah — enah mekuddeshet! amar rava: la kashya, ha — rabbi meir, ha — rabbi elazar. ha rabbi meir, deamar: adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din. ha rabbi elazar, deamar: en adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din.
May hi? ditnan: hammotzi et ishto mishshum neder — lo yachzir. mishshum shem ra — lo yachzir.

Rabbi yehuda omer: kol neder sheyyadu bo rabbim — lo yachazir. lo yadu bo rabbim — yachazir. rabbi meir omer: kol neder shetztzarich chakirat chacham — lo yachazir. vesheeno tzarich chakirat chacham — yachazir.
Rabbi elazar omer: echad tzarich veechad eno tzarich — lo yachazir. amar rabbi elazar: lo asru tzarich ella mippene sheeno tzarich. may tama derabbi yehuda? dichtiv:

a: "Velo hikkum bene yisrael ki nishbeu lahem nesie haeda", vechamma rabbim? rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: shelosha. yamim — shenayim, rabbim — shelosha. rabbi yitzchak amar: asara,  "eda" ketiv behu.

Rabbi meir omer: kol neder shetztzarich chakirat chacham — lo yachazir. rabbi elazar omer: lo asru tzarich ella mippene sheeno tzarich. bemay kamippalgi? rabbi meir savar: adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din, rabbi elazar savar: en adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din.
Rava amar: hacha beishsha chashuva askinan, deamar: la nicha li deittesar bikrovoteha.

I hachi, sefa dekatane: aval hu shehalach etzel chacham vehittiro, etzel rofe verippe oto — mekuddeshet, litne enah mekuddeshet, velema hacha beadam chashuv askinan, deamra: la nicha li deittesar bekariveh!
Ihi bechol dehu nicha la, kidresh lakish. deamar resh lakish: "tav lemetav tan du millemetav armelu", abbaye amar: deshumeshmana gavra kuresya be charata rame la.
Rav pappa amar: denappasa gavra, tikreyeh besippe vava vetetiv. rav ashe amar: dekallasa gavra, la baaya telafche lekidra. tana: vechullan mezannot vetolot bevalehen.

Kol mumin shepposlin vechulei. tana: hosifu alehen zea, veshuma, vereach happe. vehane bechahane la pasli? vehatnan: hazzaken, vehachole, vehamezoham. utenan: mumin ellu, ben kevuin ben ovrin — pesulin baadam.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina, la kashya: kan bezea overet, kan bezea sheenah overet.
Rav ashe amar: zea ammezoham ka ramet? hatam gabbe kohanim — efshar leabbora bekiyyuha dechamra. umereach happe name — efshar denaket pilpela befummeh veaved avoda. aval gabbe ishsha la efshar.

Hay shuma hechi damya? i deit ba sear — hacha vehacha pasla. i dela it ba sear, i shuma gedola hi — hacha vehacha pasla, i shuma ketanna hi — hacha vehacha la pasla, detanya: shuma sheyyesh bah sear — hare ze mum. en bah sear, gedola hare ze mum, ketanna en ze mum. veezohi gedola? peresh rabban shimon ben gamliel: ad keissar haitalki.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: beomedet al paddachtah. paddachtah — raa venippayyays hu! amar rav pappa: beomedet lah tachat kippa shel roshah, vezimnin demitchazya vezimnin dela mitchazya.

Amar rav chisda: ha milleta miggavra rabba shemia li, umannu — rabbi shela: neshachah kelev venaasa mekomo tzalleket — hare ze mum. amar rav chisda: kol ave baishsha — hare ze mum, shenneemar: "ki kolech arev umarech nave". tane rabbi natan biraa: ben dadde ishsha tefach. savar rav acha bereh derava kammeh derav ashe lememar tefach limalleyuta. amar leh rav ashe: gabbe mumin tanya, vechamma? amar abbaye: shalosh etzbaot.

Tanya, rabbi natan omer: kol ishsha sheddaddeha gassin mishshel chavroteha — hare ze mum. vechamma? amar rabbi meyaysha bar bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: tefach. umi ikka ki hay gavvna? in, deamar rabba bar bar chana: ani raiti arviyya achat shehifshila daddeha laachoreha vehenika et benah.

"Uletziyyon yeamar ish veish yullad bah vehu yechonneha elyon". amar rabbi meyaysha bar bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: echad hannolad bah, veechad hametzappe lirotah. amar abbaye: vechad minnayyhu adif kitre minnan. amar rava: vechad minnan ki salek lehatam — adif kitre minnayyhu. deha rabbi yirmeya dechi hava hacha la hava yada may kaamri rabbanan, ki selek lehatam, kare lan "bavlae tafshae".

Mishna hayu bah mumin veodah bevet aviha — haav tzarich lehavi reaya shemmishshennitarsa hayu bah mumin hallalu venistachafa sadehu. nichnesa lirshut habbaal — habbaal tzarich lehavi reaya shead shello nitarsa hayu bah mumin ellu, vehaya mikkacho mikkach taut. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: bamme devarim amurim — bemumin shebbasseter,
b: Aval bemumin shebbaggaluy eno yachol liton. veim yesh merchatz beotah hair — af mumin shebbasseter eno yachol liton, mippene shehu bodkah bikrovotav.
Gemara tama demayyte haav reaya, ha la mayyte haav reaya — (ha)baal meheman. manni? rabbi yehoshua hi, deamar: la mippiha anu chayyin.

Ema sefa: nichnesa lirshut habbaal — habbaal tzarich lehavi reaya. tama demayyte habbaal reaya, ha la mayyte habbaal reaya — (ha)av meheman. atan lerabban gamliel deamar neemenet! amar rabbi elazar: tavra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo.
Amar rava: la tema rabbi yehoshua la azel batar chazaka degufa kelal, ella: ki la azel rabbi yehoshua batar chazaka degufa, hecha deikka chazaka demamona.

Aval hecha delekka chazaka demamona — azel rabbi yehoshua batar chazaka degufa. detanya: im baheret kodem lesear lavan — tame, im sear lavan kodem labbaheret — tahor, safek — tame. verabbi yehoshua omer: keha. may "keha"? amar rabba: "keha" — tahor.
Rava amar: resha, kan nimtzeu vechan hayu. sefa name, kan nimtzeu vechan hayu.

Etiveh abbaye: nichnesa lirshut habbaal — habbaal tzarich lehavi reaya shead shello titares hayu bah mumin ellu, vehaya mikkacho mikkach taut. ad shello titares — in, mishshettitares — la, veammay? lema: kan nimtzeu vechan hayu!
Amar leh: mishshennitarsa. mishshum deikka lememar: chazaka en adam shote bechos ella im ken bodko. vehay raa venippayyays hu.
I hachi, ad shello titares name! ella amrinan: chazaka en adam mippayyes bemumin. hacha name, chazaka en adam mippayyes bemumin!

Ella: mishshennitarsa, mishshum deikka tarte: chazaka haamed hagguf al chezkato, vachazaka en adam shote bechos ella im ken bodko, vehay raa venippayyays hu. may amrat? chazaka en adam mippayyes bemumin — have

a: Chada bimkom tarte, vachada bimkom tarte la amrinan. ad shello titares — haamed hagguf al chezkato la ikka lememar. may ikka? chazaka deen adam shote bechos ella im ken bodko, vehay raa venippayyays hu — adderabba: chazaka en adam mippayyes bemumin, vehaamed mamon al chezkato.
Rav ashe amar: resha "mane leabba beyadcha", vesefa "mane li beyadcha".
Etiveh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: mode rabbi meir bemumin haruyin lavo immah mibbet aviha, sheal haav lehavi reaya. veammay? "mane li beyadcha" hu!
Hacha bemay askinan — biteret. yeteret, may reaya mayyte? reaya deraa venippayyays hu.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hammachalif para bachamor, umashach baal hachamor et happara, velo hispik baal happara limshoch et hachamor ad shemmet hachamor — al baal hachamor lehavi reaya shehaya chamoro kayyaym bishat meshichat para.
Vetanna tuna kalla. he kalla? illema
b: Kalla bevet aviha, mi dame? hatam — mayyte av reaya umappek, hacha — mayyte baal hachamor reaya umokem.
Amar rabbi abba: kalla bevet chamiha. veakkatti la dame: hatam — baal mayyte reaya umara leh lachazakeh deav, hacha — baal hachamor mayyte reaya umokem chazakeh bideh.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kalla bevet aviha, ulekiddushin.
Vela tema allibba deman deamar kiddushin lav letibbuin nittenu. ella afillu leman deamar kiddushin letibbuin nittenu — hane mille kiddushe vadday, aval kiddushe taut, i mayyte reaya — in, i la — la.

Metivi: machat shennimtzet beovi bet hakkosot, mitztzad echad — keshera. mishshene tzedadin — terefa. nimtza aleha koret dam — beyadua shehu lifne shechita, lo nimtza aleha koret dam — beyadua shehu leachar shechita.
Hugelad pi hammakka — beyadua sheshshelosha yamim kodem shechita. lo hugelad pi hammakka — hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vei yehayv tabbach deme — bae leetoye reaya umappek.
Veammay? baal behema layyte reaya venokem?
Bidla yehayv tabbacha dame. may paska?
Ella, ki ata rame bar yechezkel, amar: la tetziytinhu lehane kelale dechayel yehuda achi mishshemeh dishmuel. hachi amar shemuel: kol shennolad safek birshuto alav haraya. vetanna tuna kalla.
Metivi: machat shennimtzet beovi bet hakkosot kulei, vei dela yehayv tabbach dame — baal behema bae leetoye reaya umappek, veammay? sefeka birshut tabbach ityeylid!
Dihayv tabbach deme. umay paska? setama demilleta, kamma dela yahev inish zuze — la yahev inish chevta.
Vachachamim omrim: bamme devarim amurim — bemumin shebbasseter. amar rav nachman:

a: Venichpe — kemumin shebbasseter dame. vehane mille dikvia leh zeman, aval la kevia leh — kemumin shebbaggaluy dame.
Mishna haish shennoldu bo mumin — en kofin oto lehotzi. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim — bemumin hakketannim, aval bemumin haggedolim — kofin oto lehotzi.
Gemara rav yehuda tane noldu. chiyyay bar rav tane hayu. man deamar noldu, kol shekken hayu — (dekasavra) [deha sevara] vekabbila. man deamar hayu, aval noldu — lo.

Tenan, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim — bemumin ketannim, aval bemumin gedolim — kofin oto lehotzi. bishlama leman deamar "noldu", hayeynu deshane ben gedolim liktannim. ella leman deamar "hayu" — ma li gedolim ma li ketannim? ha sevara vekabbila!
Kisvura hi sheyyechola lekabbel, veachshav en yechola lekabbel. veellu hen mumin gedolim? peresh rabban shimon ben gamliel: [kegon] nismet eno, niktea yado, venishbera raglo.
Ittemar, rabbi abba bar yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. rava amar rav nachman: halacha kedivre chachamim.

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bechol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu — halacha kemoto, chutz mearev, vetzaydan, ureaya acharona. amorae ninhu veallibba derabbi yochanan.

Mishna veellu shekkofin oto lehotzi: mukke shechin, uvaal polippus, vehamekammetz, vehametzaref nechoshet, vehabburesi. ben shehayu ad shello nisseu, uven mishshennisseu noldu. veal kullan amar rabbi meir: af al pi shehitna immah, yechola hi shettomar: "sevura hayiti sheani yechola lekabbel, veachshav eni yechola lekabbel".

Vachachamim omrim: mekabbelet hi al korchah, chutz mimmukke shechin, mippene shemmemikkato. maase betzaydon bevuresi echad shemmet, vehaya lo ach buresi. amru chachamim: yechola hi shettomar "leachicha hayiti yechola lekabbel, ulecha eni yechola lekabbel".
Gemara may "baal polippus"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: reach hachotem. bematnita tana: reach happe. rav assi matni ippecha. umannach ba simana: shemuel la pasek pummeh mikkulleh pirkin.
Vehamekammetz. may "mekammetz"? amar rav yehuda: ze hamekabbetz tzoat kelavim. metivi: "mekammetz" ze buresi! uletamaych tikshe lach matnitin: "hamekammetz vehametzaref nechoshet vehabburesi"!
Bishlama matnitin la kashya: kan bevuresi gadol, kan bevuresi katan. ella lerav yehuda kashya! tannae hi, detanya: "mekammetz" ze buresi, veyesh omrim: ze hamekammetz tzoat kelavim.

Vehametzaref nechoshet vehabburesi. may "metzaref nechoshet"? rav ashe amar: chashle dude. rabba bar bar chana amar: ze hamechattech nechoshet meikkaro. tanya kevoteh derabba bar bar chana: ezehu "metzaref"? ze hamechattech nechoshet meikkaro.
Amar rav: haomer "eni zan veeni mefarnes" — yotzi veyitten ketubba. azal rabbi elazar amra lishmata kammeh dishmuel. amar: akkesu seare leelazar. ad shekkofin oto lehotzi — yichpuhu lazun.
Verav: en adam dar im nachash bichfifa. ki selek rabbi zera, ashkecheh lerabbi binyamin bar yefet deyatev vekaamar la, mishshemeh derabbi yochanan. amar leh: al da akkesu searin leelazar bevavel.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: en meassin ella lifsulot. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar: kegon almana lechohen gadol, ugerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer. aval nasa ishsha veshaha immah eser shanim velo yalda — en kofin oto.

Verav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel: afillu nasa ishsha veshaha immah eser shanim velo yalda — kofin oto. tenan, ellu shekkofin oto lehotzi: mukke shechin uvaal polippus. bishlama lerav assi: derabbanan katane, deorayyta la katane. ella lerav tachlifa bar avimi, litne nasa ishsha veshaha immah eser shanim velo yalda — kofin oto.
Amar rav nachman, la kashya: ha bemille, ha beshote. matkef la rabbi abba: "bidvarim lo yivvaser aved"! ella amar rabbi abba: ha veha beshote,
b: Hatam, ki amra "havyana bahadeh" — shavkinan la. hacha, af al gav deamra "havyana bahadeh" — la shavkinan la. vahare mukke shechin, deaf al gav daamarah "havyana bahadeh" — la shavkinan la. ditnan: chutz mimmukke shechin, mippene shemmemikkato vekatane!
Hatam ki amra "dayyrana bahadeh besahade" — shavkinan la. hacha af al gav deamra "dayyrana bahadeh besahade" — la shavkinan la.

Tanya, amar rabbi yose: sach li zaken echad meanshe yerushalayim: esrim vearbaa mukke shechin hen, vechullan amru chachamim tashmish kashe lahen, uvaale ratan kashe mikkullan. mimmay have? detanya: hikkiz dam veshimmesh — havayin lo banim vitikin. hakkizu shenehem veshimmeshu — havayin lo banim baale ratan. amar rav pappa: la amaran ella dela taem midde, aval taem midde — let lan ba.

May simaneh? dalfan eneh, vedayyvi nechireh, veayte leh rira mippummeh, uremu didve illaveh. umay asuteh? amar abbaye: pila, veludana, girda deegoza, vegirda deashpa, uchelil malka, umetachla dedikla summaka. veshalek lehu bahade hadade, umeayyel leh leveta deshesha. vei la ikka beta deshesha — meayyel leh leveta deshav livne vaaricha,
Venatel leh telat mea kase al resheh, ad derafya arita democheh, vekara lemocheh umayyte arba tarfe deasa umadle kol chad kara umotev chad, veshakel bitzvata vekale leh. dei la — hadar illaveh.

Machriz rabbi yochanan: hizzaharu mizzevuve (shel) baale ratan. rabbi zera la hava yatev bezikeh. rabbi elazar la ayel beuhleh. rabbi amme verabbi assi la havo achli mibbee dehahi mevoa. rabbi yehoshua ben levi michrach behu veasek battora. amar: "ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen", im chen maala al lomdeha, aggone la maggena?

Ki hava shachev, amaru leh lemalach hammavet: zil, aved leh reuteh. azal itchazi leh. amar leh: achvi li duchetay. amar leh: lechayye. amar leh: hav li sakkinach, dilma mevaatat li beorcha. yahava nihaleh. ki meta lehatam dalyay, ka machve leh. shevavr nefal lehahu gisa.

Nakteh bekarna diglimeh. amar leh: bishvuata dela atena. amar kudesha berich hu: i itteshil ashshevuata — nehdar. i la — la nehdar. amar leh: hav li sakkinay. la hava ka yahev leh. nefaka bat kala vaamara leh: hav nihaleh, demittava leviryayta. machriz eliyyahu kammeh: pannu makom levar levay! pannu makom levar levay!

Azal, ashkecheh lerabbi shimon ben yochay dahava yatev al telat asar tachtake pizza. amar leh: at hu bar levay? amar leh: hen. nirata keshet beyamecha? amar leh: hen. im ken, i atta bar levay. vela hi, dela havay midde. ella savar: la achzek tevuta lenafshay.

Rabbi chanina bar pappa shoshvineh hava. ki hava ka naycha nafsheh, amaru leh lemalach hammavet: zil aved leh reuteh. azal legabbeh veitchazi leh. amar leh: shivkay telatin yom ad denahdar talmuday. deamri: ashre mi shebba lechan vetalmudo beyado. shavkeh, levatar telatin yomin azal itchazi leh. amar leh: achvi li duchetay. amar leh: lechayye. amar leh: hav li sakkinach dilma mevaatat li beorcha. amar leh: kechavrach baet lemibad li?

Amar leh: ayyti sefer tora vachazi mi ikka midde dichtiv beh dela kayyemteh. amar leh: mi ikkaracht bevaale ratan veiasekt battora? vaafillu hachi, ki nach nafsheh afsek leh ammuda denura ben dideh lealma. ugemiri dela mafsek ammuda denura ella lechad bedara o litren bedara.

Kerav legabbeh rabbi alekkesanderi, amar: "ase bishvil kevod chachamim". la ashgach. "ase bishvil kevod avicha". la ashgach. "ase bishvil kevod atzmecha", istallak. amar abbaye: leappoke mimman dela kayyem (afillu ot achat). amar leh rav adda bar matna: leappoke mimmar dela it leh maake leiggareh. vela hi: miAdonai hava, vehahi shata hu deshadyeh zika.

Amar rabbi chanina: mippene ma en baale ratan bevavel — mippene sheochlin teradin, veshotin shechar shel hizme. amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma en metzorain bevavel — mippene sheochlin teradin, veshotin shechar, verochatzin beme ferat.
Hadaran alach hammaddir et ishto

a: Haishsha shennaflu lah nechasim ad shello titares — modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyaym. naflu lah mishshennitarsa — bet shammay omrim: timkor, uvet hillel omrim: lo timkor. ellu vaellu modim sheim machra venatna kayyaym.
Amar rabbi yehuda: amru chachamim lifne rabban gamliel: hoil vezacha baishsha, lo yizke bannechasim? amar lahem: al hachadashim anu boshim, ella sheattem megalgelin alenu et hayyeshanim?!

Naflu lah mishshennisset, ellu veellu modim sheim machra venatna, shehabbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot. ad shello nisset venisset, rabban gamliel omer: im machra venatna — kayyaym. amar rabbi chanina ben akavya, amru lifne rabban gamliel: hoil vezacha baishsha, lo yizke bannechasim? amar lahem: al hachadashim anu boshim, ella sheattem megalgelin alenu hayyeshanim?!
Rabbi shimon cholek ben nechasim linchasim, nechasim hayyeduin labbaal — lo timkor, veim machra venatna — batel. sheenan yeduin labbaal — lo timkor, veim machra venatna — kayyaym.
Gemara may shena resha dela peligi, umay shena sefa difligi?
Amri deve rabbi yannay: resha — bizchutah naflu. sefa — bizchuto naflu.
Im bizchuto naflu, ki machra venatna ammay kayyaym? ella: resha — vadday bizchutah naflu. sefa — emar bizchutah, emar bizchuto. lechattechilla lo timkor, im machra venatna — kayyaym.
Amar rabbi yehuda, amru lifne rabban gamliel. ibbaya lehu, rabbi yehuda allechattechilla, o addiavad?
b: Ta shema, detanya, amar rabbi yehuda: amru lifne rabban gamliel: hoil vezo ishto vezo ishto — zo michrah batel, af zo michrah batel! amar lahen: al hachadashim anu boshim, ella sheattem megalgelim alenu et hayyeshanim? shema minna diavad kaamar: shema minna.

Tanya, amar rabbi chanina ben akavya: lo kach heshivan rabban gamliel lachachamim, ella kach heshivan: lo im amartem binsua — shekken balah zakkay bimtziatah uvemaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha, tomru baarusa sheen balah zakkay lo bimtziatah velo bemaase yadeha velo bahafarat nedareha!

Amru lo: rabbi, machra lah ad shello nisset, nisset veachar kach machra, mahu? amar lehu: af zo mocheret venotenet vekayyaym. amru lo: hoil vezacha baishsha, lo yizke bannechasim?! amar lahem: al hachadashim anu boshin, ella sheattem megalgelin alenu et hayyeshanim?!
Vehaanan tenan: ad shello nisset venisset, rabban gamliel omer: im machra venatna — kayyaym.

Amar rav zevid, teni: mocheret venotenet vekayyaym. rav pappa amar, la kashya: ha rabbi yehuda allibba derabban gamliel, ha rabbi chanina ben akavya allibba derabban gamliel. verabbi chanina ben akavya kevet shammay? hachi kaamar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al davar ze.
Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: ben shennaflu lah nechasim ad shello nitarsa, ben shennaflu lah nechasim mishshennitarsa, venisset — habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot.

Keman? delo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi chanina ben akavya! inhu deamri kerabbotenu. detanya, rabbotenu chazru venimnu: ben shennaflu lah ad shello titares, uven shennaflu lah mishshennitarsa venisset — habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot.

Mishshennisset ellu veellu modim. lema tenena letakkanat usha? deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina, beusha hitkinu: haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah umeta — habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot.
Matnitin — bechayyeha uleferot, takkanat usha — begufah shel karka uleachar mita.

Rabbi shimon cholek ben nechasim. ellu hen yeduin veellu hen sheenan yeduin? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: yeduin — mekarkee. sheenan yeduin — mittaltelin. verabbi yochanan amar: ellu vaellu yeduin hen. veellu hen sheenan yeduin — kol sheyyoshevet kan venaflu lah nechasim bimdinat hayyam.
Tanya name hachi: ellu hen sheenan yeduin — kol sheyyoshevet kan venaflu lah nechasim bimdinat hayyam.
Hahi itteta devaaya detavrechinhu lenichsa miggavra, ketavtinhu livratta. innesiva veiggarasha.

a: Atay lekammeh derav nachman, kareh rav nachman lishtara. azal rav anan lekammeh demar ukeva, amar leh: chazi mar nachman chaklaa hechi mekara shetare deinashe. amar leh: ema li izi, gufa deovada hechi hava?
Amar leh: hachi vehachi hava. amar leh: shetar mavrachat ka amrat? hachi amar rav chanilay bar idi amar shemuel: more horaa ani: im yavo shetar mavrachat leyadi — ekraennu.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: tama may? dela shavek inish nafsheh veyahev leacharine. hane mille leacharine, aval livratta yahayva! afillu hachi: bimkom beratta, nafshah adifa la.
Metivi: harotza shettavriach nechaseha mibbalah, ketzad hi osa? kotevet shetar passim laacherim, divre rabban shimon ben gamliel.
Vachachamim omrim: ratza — metzachek bah. ad shettichtov lo mehayyom velichsheertze.
Tama dechatva leh hachi, ha la katva leh hachi — kenanhi lokeach!
Amar rabbi zera, la kashya: ha — bechulla, ha — bemiktzata.
Vei la kenanhi lokeach — nikninhu baal! amar abbaye: asaum kinchasim sheen yeduin labbaal, veallibba derabbi shimon.
Mishna naflu lah kesafim — yillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot. perot hattelushin min hakkarka — yillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot.

[Perot] hamechubbarim bakkarka? amar rabbi meir: shamin otah kamma hi yafa beferot vechamma hi yafa belo perot, umotar — yillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot. vachachamim omrim: hamechubbarim lakkarka — shello, vehattelushin min hakkarka — shellah, veyillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot.

Rabbi shimon omer: mekom sheyyippa kocho bichnisatah — hora kocho bitziatah. mekom shehora kocho bichnisatah — yippa kocho bitziatah. ketzad? perot hamechubbarim lakkarka, bichnisatah — shello, uvitziatah — shellah. vehattelushin min hakkarka, bichnisatah — shellah, uvitziatah — shello.
Gemara peshita: ara uvatte — ara. batte vedikle — batte. dikle veilane — dikle. ilane vegufene — ilane.
Ibba, zardeta, ufira dechavvre, amri la pera veamri la karna. kelala demilleta: gizo machlif — pera, en gizo machlif — karna.
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi oshaya amar rabbi yannay, veamri la, amar rabbi abba amar rabbi oshaya amar rabbi yannay: haggonev
b: Velad behemat melog — meshallem tashlume chefel laishsha.
Keman? la kerabbanan vela kachananya! detanya: velad behemat melog levaal, velad shifchat melog laishsha, vachananya ben achi yoshiyya amar: asu velad shifchat melog kivlad behemat melog.
Afillu tema divre hakkol: pera takkinu le rabbanan, pera defera la takkinu le rabbanan.
Bishlama lachananya — hayeynu dela chayyshinan lemita.
Ella rabbanan i chayyshi lemita — afillu velad behemat melog name la. vei la chayyshi lemita — afillu velad shifchat melog name?
Leolam chayyshi lemita, veshane behema deikka orah.

Amar rav huna bar chiyyay amar shemuel: halacha kachananya. amar rava amar rav nachman: af al gav deamar shemuel halacha kachananya, mode chananya sheim nitgarsha — notenet damim venotaltan, mippene shevach bet aviha.

Amar rava amar rav nachman: hichnisa lo ez lachalavah verachel legizzatah, vetarnegolet levetzatah, vedekel leferotav — ochel veholech ad shettichle hakkeren. amar rav nachman: ayyila leh gelima — pera have, mikkasse beh veazel ad dechalya.
Keman? ki hay tanna, detanya: hammelach vehachol — hare ze perot. pir shel gofrit, machporet shel tzarif, rabbi meir omer: keren. vachachamim omrim: perot.
Rabbi shimon omer makom sheyyippa kocho. rabbi shimon hayeynu tanna kamma? amar rava: mechubbarin bishat yetzia ikka benayyhu.

Mishna naflu lah avadim ushefachot zekenim — yimmachru, veyillakach mehen karka, vehu ochel perot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo timkor, mippene shehen shevach bet aviha. naflu lah zetim ugefanim zekenim — yimmachru, veyillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot. rabbi yehuda omer: lo timkor, mippene shehen shevach bet aviha.
Gemara amar rav kahana amar rav: machloket shennaflu besade shellah, aval besade sheenah shellah — divre hakkol timkor, mishshum deka chalya karna.

Matkef la rav yosef: hare avadim ushefachot, dechi sade sheenah shellah dame, ufeligi! ella i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav kahana amar rav: machaloket besade sheenah shellah, aval besade shellah — divre hakkol lo timkor, mippene shevach bet aviha.
Mishna hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto, hotzi harebe veachal kima, kima veachal harebe — ma shehotzi hotzi, uma sheachal achal. hotzi velo achal — yishshava kamma hotzi, veyittol.
Gemara vechamma kima? amar rabbi assi: afillu gerogeret achat, vehu sheachalah derech kavod. amar

a: Rabbi abba, amri be rav: afillu shigra detamre. bae rav bivi: chuvetza detamre may? teku.
La achla derech kavod may? amar ulla: peligi ba tere amorae bemareva, chad amar: bichissar, vechad amar: bichdinar.
Amri dayyayne defumebdita: avad rav yehuda ovada bachavile zemorot. rav yehuda letameh, deamar rav yehuda: achalah orla, sheviit, vechilayim — hare zo chazaka.
Amar rav yaakov amar rav chisda: hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto ketanna — kemotzi al nichse acher dame. may tama — avadu ba rabbanan takkanta, ki hechi dela nifsedinhu.

Hahi itteta dinfalu la arba mea zuze be chozae, azal gavra appek shet mea ayytay arba mea. bahade dekaate, itzterich leh chad zuza ushekal minnayyhu. ata lekammeh derabbi amme, amar leh: ma shehotzi — hotzi, uma sheachal — achal.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerabbi amme: hane mille hecha dekaachel pera, ha karna kaachel vehotzaa hi. im ken, have leh hotzi velo achal, yishshava kamma hotzi, veyittol.
Yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol. amar rabbi assi: vehu sheyyesh shevach keneged hotzaa. lemay hilcheta? amar abbaye: sheim haya shevach yater al hotzaa — notel et hahotzaa belo shevua.
Amar leh rava: im ken, ate leiarome! ella amar rava: sheim hayta hotzaa yetera al hashshevach — en lo ella hotzaa shiur shevach, uvishvua.
Ibbaya lehu: baal shehorid arisin tachtav, mahu? addata devaal nachet. istallayk leh baal, istallayku lehu. o dilma: addata deara nachet, veara ki kayyma — laarise kayyma?
Matkef la rava bar rav chanan: may shena mehayyored letoch sede chavero unetaah shello birshut, shamin lo, veyado al hattachtona?
Hatam lekka inish detarach, hacha ikka baal detarach.
May have ala? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: chazenan i baal aris hu — istallak leh baal, istallaku lehu. i baal lav aris hu, ara laarise kayyma.
Ibbaya lehu: baal shemmachar karka leferot, mahu? mi amrinan may dekane (la) akni, o dilma: ki takkinu le rabbanan perot levaal —
b: Mishshum revavch beta, aval lezabbone — la? yehuda mar bar marimar mishshemeh derava amar: ma sheasa, asuy. rav pappa amar mishshemeh derava: lo asa velo chelum.
Amar rav pappa: ha dihuda mar bar marimar lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar. dehahi itteta deayyila leh legavra tarte amhata, azal gavra nesev itteta achariti, ayyel la chada minnayyhu.
Atay lekammeh derava, tzevavcha, la ashgach ba. man dachaza savar mishshum desavar ma sheasa asuy. vela hi, mishshum revavch beta — veha ka ravavch.
Vehilcheta: baal shemmachar karka leferot — lo asa velo kelum. may tama? abbaye amar: chayyshinan shemma tachsif. rava amar: mishshum revavch beta.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu ara dimkarva lemata, i name: baal aris hu. i name, zuze veka aved behu iska.
Mishna shomeret yavam shennaflu lah nechasim — modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyaym.

Meta, ma yaasu bichtubbatah uvinchasim hannichnasin vehayyotzin immah? bet shammay omrim: yachleku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav. uvet hillel omrim: nechasim bechezkatan, uchetubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal. nechasim hannichnasim vehayyotzim immah — bechezkat yorshe haav.
Hinniach achiv maot — yillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot. perot hattelushin min hakkarka — yillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot.
Hamechubbarin bakkarka, amar rabbi meir: shamin otan kamma hen yafin beferot, vechamma hen yafin belo perot, vehammotar — yillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot.
Vachachamim omrim: perot hamechubbarin bakkarka — shello. hattelushin min hakkarka — kol hakkodem zacha bahen. kadam hu — zacha, kadma hi — yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot.
Kenasah, hare hi keishto lechol davar. bilvad shettehe ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon.

Lo yomar lah "hare ketubbatich munnachat al hashshulchan", ella kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah. vechen: lo yomar adam leishto "hare ketubbatich munnachat al hashshulchan", ella kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah.
Gershah — en lah ella ketubba. hechzira — hare hi kechol hannashim, veen lah ella ketubba bilvad.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: shomeret yavam shemmeta, mi kovrah? yorshe habbaal kavri la deka yarti ketubba, o dilma yorshe haav kavri la, deka yarti nechasim hannichnasin vehayyotzin immah? amar rav amram: ta shema, detanya: shomeret yavam shemmeta —

a: Yorsheha yorshe ketubbatah chayyayvin bikvuratah. amar abbaye, af anan name tenena: almana nizzonet minnichse yetomin, umaase yadeha shellahen, veen chayyayvin bikvuratah. yorsheha yorshe chetubbatah chayyayvin bikvuratah, veezohi almana sheyyesh lah shene yorshin? heve omer: zo shomeret yavam.
Amar rava, velema: ach ani yoresh. ishto en ani kover. amar leh abbaye: mishshum devain alav mishshene tzedadin: im achiv yoresh — yikbor et ishto. im eno kover et ishto — yitten ketubbatah.
Amar leh, hachi ka amena: ach ani yoresh, et ishto en ani kover. vei mishshum ketubba — lo nittena ketubba liggavot mechayyim.
Man shamat leh deit leh midrash ketubba — bet shammay. veshaminan lehu levet shammay deamri: shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame!
Ditnan: metu baalehen ad shello shatu — bet shammay omrim: notlot ketuva velo shotot, uvet hillel omrim: o shotot o lo notlot ketuva.
O shotot?! "vehevi haish et ishto el hakkohen" amar rachamana, velekka! ella: mittoch shello shotot — lo notlot ketuva.
Bet shammay omrim: notlot ketuva velo shotot. veammay? sefeka hu: safek zannay safek la zannay — vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday.
Kasavri bet shammay: shetar haomed ligbot — kegavuy dame.
Veha baenan: "keshettinnasi leacher titteli ma shekkatuv lichi", velekka?
Amar rav ashe: yavam name keacher dame.
Shelach leh rava leabbaye beyad rav shemaya bar zera: umi nittena ketubba liggavot mechayyim?
Vehatanya, rabbi abba omer, shaalti et somchos: harotze sheyyimkor benichse achiv, ketzad hu ose? im kohen hu — yaase seuda vifayyes. im yisrael hu — megaresh beget veyachzir.
b: Vei salka datin nittena ketubba liggavot mechayyim, neyayched la shiur ketubba, vehashshear lizabben! uletamaych, velotva mimmatnitin: lo yomar lah hare ketubbatich munnachat lich al hashshulchan, ella kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah?!

Hatam etza tova ka mashma lan. dei la tema hachi, sefa dekatane: vechen lo yomar adam leishto "hare ketubbatich munnachat lich al hashshulchan", ella kol nechasav achrain lichtubbat ishto — i bae leh lezabbone, hacha name dela matze mezabben?! ella etza tova kamashma lan, hacha name etza tova ka mashma lan,
Ella, derabbi abba kashya? derabbi abba name la kashya, mishshum eva.
Hahu gavra dinfala leh yevama befumebdita, bae achu lemifsela (la) begitta minneh.
Amar leh: may dataych — mishshum nichse? ana benichse palegna lach.

Amar rav yosef: kevan daamur rabbanan la lizabben, af al gav dezabben — la hava zevineh zevine. detanya: mi shemmet vehinniach shomeret yavam, vehinniach nechasim bemea mane, af al pi shekketubbatah enah ella mane — lo yimkor, shekkol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah.

Amar leh abbaye: vechol hecha daamur rabbanan la lizabben — af al gav dezabben la hava zevineh zevine? vehatnan: bet shammay omrim timkor, uvet hillel omrim lo timkor, ellu veellu modim sheim machra venatna — kayyaym. shalchuha lekammeh derabbi chanina bar pappe, shalcha: kidrav yosef.
Amar abbaye: attu rabbi chanina bar pappe kife tela la? shalchuha lekammeh derav minyome bereh derav nechumi, shalcha: kidabbaye, vei amar ba rav yosef tama acharina shilchu li.

Nefak rav yosef dak veashkach detanya: hare shehaya noshe beachiv, umet vehinniach shomeret yavam, lo yomar: hoil vesheani yoresh — hechzakti, ella motziin miyyavam, veyikkach bahen karka vehu ochel perot.
Amar leh abbaye: dilma detava leh avadu leh. amar leh: tanna tane motziin, veat amrat detava leh avadu leh?
Hadur shalchuha kammeh derav minyome bereh derav nechumi. amar lehu: hachi amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: zo enah mishna.
May tama? illema mishshum dehavu lehu mittalteli, umittalteli lichtubba la meshabedi — dilma rabbi meir hi, deamar: mittalteli meshabedi lichtubba.
Veella — mishshum deamar la: at lav baalat devarim didi at.

a: Dilma rabbi natan hi. detanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, vachavero bachavero, minnayin shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze — talmud lomar: "venatan laasher asham lo".
Ella: la ashkechan tanna demachmir tere chumere bichtubba, ella i kerabbi meir i kerabbi natan.
Amar rava: im ken, hayeynu dishmana leh leabbaye deamar: "zo enah mishna", vela yadana may hi.

Hahu gavra dinfala leh yevama bemata machseya. bea achu lemifsela begitta minneh. amar leh: may dataych, i mishshum nichse — ana benichse palegna lach. amar leh: mistefena deavdat li kedaavayd pumebditaa rammaa. amar leh: i baet — pelog lach mehasheta.

Amar mar bar rav ashe: af al gav dechi ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: haomer lachavero "lech umeshoch para zo velo tihye kenuya lecha ella leachar sheloshim yom", leachar sheloshim yom kana, vaafillu omedet baagam.
Hatam — beyado, hacha — lav beyado.
Veha ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: la kane! la kashya: ha daamar leh "kene meachshav", ha dela amar leh "kene meachshav".
Beo minneh meulla: yibbem veachar kach chillek, mahu? lo asa velo chelum. chillek veachar kach yibbem, mahu? lo asa velo chelum.
Matkef la rav sheshet: hasheta yibbem veachar kach chillek, lo asa velo chelum, chillek veachar kach yibbem mibbaya?! shene maasim havo.
Ki ata ravin, amar resh lakish: ben yibbem veachar kach chillek, ben chillek veachar kach yibbem — lo asa velo chelum. vehilcheta: lo asa velo chelum.
Vachachamim omrim: perot hamechubbarim lakkarka — shello. ammay? veha kol nechasav achrain vearvain lichtubbatah! amar resh lakish: teni — shellah.
Kenasah — hare hi keishto. lemay hilcheta? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: lomar shemmegarshah beget umachzirah. megarshah beget peshita?
Mahu detema: "veyibbemah" amar rachamana, vaadayin yibbumin harishonim aleha. la tisge la beget ella bachalitza, ka mashma lan.
Machzirah: peshita!
b: Mahu detema: mitzva dirma rachamana aleh avda, vehasheta tekum aleh beissur eshet ach, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! amar kera "ulekachah lo leishsha". kevan shellekachah — naaset keishto.
Bilvad shettehe ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon. may tama — ishsha hiknu lo min hashshamayim.
Vei let la merishon, it la mishsheni. kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah.
Lo yomar lah "hare ketubbatich". may vechen?
Mahu detema: hatam hu dela ketav lah "diknay udekanena", aval hacha dichtav la "diknay udekanena", ema samcha data — ka mashma lan.
Gershah — en lah ella ketubbatah. gershah — in, lo gershah — la. ka mashma lan kidrabbi abba.
Hechzira — hare hi kechol hannashim, veen lah ella ketubbatah. hechzira, may ka mashma lan? tenena: hamegaresh et haishsha umachzira, al menat ketubba rishona machzirah!
Mahu detema: ishto hu deihu ketav la ketubba minneh, aval yevimto dela ihu ketav la, hecha degarsha veahdera — ema ketubbeta minneh, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav yehuda: barishona hayu kotvin livtula matayim ulealmana mane, vehayu mazkinin velo hayu nosin nashim, ad shebba shimon ben shatach vetikken, kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah.

Tanya name hachi: barishona hayu kotvin livtula matayim ulealmana mane, vehayu mazkinin velo hayu nosin nashim. hitkinu sheyyihyu mannichin otah bevet aviha. vaadayin: keshehu koes aleha, omer lah: "lechi etzel ketubbatich",
Hitkinu sheyyihyu mannichin otah bevet chamiha. ashirot osot otah kelatot shel kesef veshel zahav, aniyyot hayu osot otah avit shel meme raglayim.
Vaadayin, keshekkoes aleha omer lah: "teli ketubbatich vatzei". ad shebba shimon ben shatach vetikken, sheyyehe kotev lah: kol nechasay achrain lichtubbatah.
Hadaran alach haishsha

a: Hakkotev leishto: "din udevarim en li binchasayich" — hare ze ochel perot bechayyeha, veim meta yorshah. im ken, lamma katav lah "din udevarim en li binchasayich"? sheim machra venatna — kayyaym.

Katav lah "din udevarim en li binchasayich uveferotehen" — hare ze eno ochel perot bechayyeha, veim meta — yorshah. rabbi yehuda omer: leolam ochel pere ferot. ad sheyyichtov la "din udevarim en li binchasayich uveferotehen uvefere ferotehen ad olam".

Katav la "din udevarim en li binchasayich uveferotehen uvefere ferotehen bechayyayich uvemotech" — eno ochel perot bechayyeha, veim meta — eno yorshah. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im meta — yirashenna, mippene shemmatne al ma shekkatuv battora, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora — tenao batel.
Gemara tane rabbi chiyyay: "haomer leishto".
Vechi ketav la hachi, may have? vehatanya: haomer lachavero "din udevarim en li al sade zo", "veen li esek bah", "veyaday mesullakot hemenna" — lo amar kelum!

Amri deve rabbi yannay: bechotev lah veodah arusa, kidrav kahana. deamar rav kahana: nachala habbaa leadam mimmakom acher — adam matne aleha shello yirashenna, vechidrava. deamar rava: haomer "i efshi betakkanat chachamim kegon zo" — shomin lo.
May "kegon zo"? kidrav huna amar rav. deamar rav huna amar rav: yechola ishsha shettomar levalah "eni nizzonet veeni osa".
I hachi, afillu nesua name?
Amar abbaye: nesua — yado keyadah. rava amar: yado adifa miyyadah. nafka minna leshomeret yavam.
Ibbaya lehu: kanu miyyado, mahu? amar rav yosef: middin udevarim kanu miyyado. rav nachman amar: miggufah shel karka kanu miyyado. amar abbaye: mistabbera milleta derav yosef
b: Beorer. aval beomed, miggufah shel karka kanu miyyado.
