Amar ammemar: hilcheta, miggufah shel karka kanu miyyado. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: beorer o beomed? lemay nafka minna, lechidrav yosef. amar leh: la shemia li. kelomar: la sevira li.
Im ken lamma katav lah vechulei. vetema leh: mikkol mille sallekt nafshach! amar abbaye: yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona.
Veema mippere? amar abbaye: "butzina tav mikkara".

Veema miyyerushsha! amar abbaye: mita shechicha, mechira la shechicha. vechi mesallek inish nafsheh mimmilleta dela shechicha, mimmilleta dishchicha la mesallek inish nafsheh. rav ashe amar, "binchasayich" — velo beferotehen, "binchasayich" — velo leachar mita.

Rabbi yehuda omer: leolam hu ochel pere ferot. tanu rabbanan: ellu hen perot veellu hen pere ferot? hichnisa lo karka veasta perot — hare hen perot. machar perot velakach mehen karka veasta perot — hare hen pere ferot.
Ibbaya lehu: lerabbi yehuda "pere ferot" davka, o dilma "ad olam" davka, o dilma tarvayyhu davka?
Im timtze lomar "pere ferot" davka, "ad olam" lema li? ha ka mashma lan: kevan dichtav la "pere ferot", keman dichtav la "ad olam" dame.
Veim timtze lomar "ad olam" davka, "pere ferot" lema li? ha ka mashma lan: af al gav dichtav la "pere ferot", i ketav la "ad olam" — in, i la — la.

Veim timtze lomar tarvayyhu davka, tarte lema li? tzericha, dei ketav la "pere ferot", velo ketav lah "ad olam", hava amena: pere ferot hu dela achel, aval pera defere ferot — achel, lehachi itzterich "ad olam". vei ketav la "ad olam", vela ketav lah "pere ferot", hava amena: leolam apperot kae, lehachi itzterich "pere ferot".
Ibbaya lehu, katav lah: "din udevarim en li binchasayich uvefere ferot", mahu sheyyochal perot? mippere ferot sallek nafsheh, mippere la sallek nafsheh, o dilma: mikkol mille sallek nafsheh?
Peshita demikkol mille sallek nafsheh. dei amrat mippere ferot sallek nafsheh, mippere la sallek nafsheh: kevan deachlinhu leferot — pere ferot mehecha?
Velitamaych — ha ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: leolam hu ochel pere ferot kulei. kevan deachlinhu lefere, pere ferot mehecha? ella bidshayyayra, hacha name bidshayyayr.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kulei. amar rav: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, vela mittameh.

May halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel vela mittameh? illema halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, deamar: im meta yirashenna, velav mittameh, deillu rabban shimon ben gamliel savar: matne al ma shekkatuv battora — tenao batel, verav savar: tenao kayyaym, vekasavar: yerushshat habbaal derabbanan, vachachamim asu chizzuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora.

a: Vesavar rav tenao kayyaym? veha ittemar: haomer lachavero al menat sheen lecha alay onaa, rav amar: yesh lo alav onaa. ushemuel amar: en lo alav onaa.

Ella: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar: hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora — tenao batel, velav mittameh, deillu rabban shimon ben gamliel savar: meta — yirashenna, verav savar: meta — lo yirashenna.
Hay mittameh vela kehilcheteh hu!

Ella: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar im meta yirashenna, velav mittameh, deillu rabban shimon ben gamliel savar bidorayyta tenao batel — ha bidrabbanan tenao kayyaym. verav savar afillu bidrabbanan — tenao batel.
Hay ketameh uchehilcheteh hu, verav mosif hu!

Ella: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar im meta yirashenna, velav mittameh, deillu rabban shimon ben gamliel savar yerushshat habbaal deorayyta, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora — tenao batel. verav savar: yerushshat habbaal derabbanan, vachachamim asu chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora.
Verav savar yerushshat habbaal derabbanan? vehatnan, rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: hayyoresh et ishto, yachzir livne mishpacha, vinakke lahen min haddamim.
Vehavenan ba: may kasavar? i kasavar yerushshat habbaal deorayyta, ammay yachzir? vei derabbanan, damim may avidtayyhu?
Veamar rav: leolam kasavar yerushshat habbaal deorayyta, uchegon shehorishattu ishto bet hakkevarot, mishshum pegam mishpacha amur rabbanan lishkol deme velayhdar.
Umay "yenakke lahen min haddamim" — deme kever ishto. kidtanya: hammocher kivro, vederech kivro, maamado, umekom hespedo — bain bene mishpacha vekovrin oto beal korcho, mishshum pegam mishpacha!
Rav letameh derabbi yochanan ben beroka kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.

Mishna mi shemmet vehinniach ishsha uvaal chov veyorshin, vehaya lo pikkadon o milva beyad acherim, rabbi tarfon omer: yinnatnu lakkoshel shebbahen. rabbi akiva omer: en merachamin baddin, ella yinnatnu layyorshin. shekkullan tzerichin shevua, veen hayyorshin tzerichin shevua.

Hinniach perot telushin min hakkarka, kol hakkodem bahen — zacha bahen. zachta ishsha yoter mikketubbatah, uvaal chov yoter al chovo, hammotar — rabbi tarfon omer: yinnatnu lakkoshel shebbahen. rabbi akiva omer: en merachamin baddin, ella yinnatnu layyorshin. shekkullam tzerichin shevua, veen hayyorshin tzerichin shevua.

Gemara lema li lemitne milva, lamma li lemitne pikkadon? tzericha, dei tena milva, beha kaamar rabbi tarfon, mishshum demilva lehotzaa nittena. aval pikkadon, deiteh beeneh — ema mode leh lerabbi akiva.
Vei tena ha, beha kaamar rabbi akiva, aval behach — ema mode lerabbi tarfon, tzericha.
May "lakkoshel"? rabbi yose berabbi chanina omer: lakkoshel shebbiraya. rabbi yochanan amar: lichtubbat ishsha, mishshum chinna.
Ketannae, rabbi binyamin omer: lakkoshel shebbiraya, vehu kasher. rabbi elazar omer: lichtubbat ishsha, mishshum chinna.
Hinniach perot hattelushin. verabbi akiva, may irya motar? kullehu name deyorshin havu? in hachi name, veayyeyde deamar rabbi tarfon motar, tena ihu name motar.
b: Verabbi akiva, tefisa la mahneya kelal? amar rava amar rav nachman: vehu shettafas mechayyim.
Ulerabbi tarfon, demannechi hecha? rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: vehu shetztzevurin umunnachin birshut harabbim, aval besimta — lo. verabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: afillu besimta.
Dun dayyayne kerabbi tarfon, veahdereh resh lakish leovada minnayyhu. amar leh rabbi yochanan: asita keshel tora.
Lema beha kamippalgi: demar savar taa bidvar mishna chozer, umar savar taa bidvar mishna eno chozer?
La, dechulle alma taa bidvar mishna chozer. vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar halacha kerabbi akiva mechavero velo merabbo, umar savar halacha afillu merabbo.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma halacha kerabbi akiva mechavero velo merabbo. vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar rabbi tarfon rabbo hava, umar savar chavero hava.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma chavero hava, vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar halacha ittemar, umar savar mattin ittemar.

Kariveh derabbi yochanan tefus para deyatme missimta. ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar lehu: shappir tefastuha. ato lekammeh derabbi shimon ben lakish, amar lehu: zilu ahdur. ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan. amar lehu: ma eese? shekkenegdi chaluk alay.

Hahu bakkara deyatme detafsi tora minneh. baal chov amar: mechayyim tefesna leh. uvakkara amar: leachar mita tafseh. ato lekammeh derav nachman. amar leh: it lecha sahade detafseh? amar leh: lav. amar leh: miggo deyachol lememar "lakuach hu beyadi", yachol name lememar "mechayyim tefesna leh".
Vehaamar resh lakish: haggodrot en lahen chazaka! shane tora dimsira leroe.

Deve nesia tefus amta deyatme missimta. yetev rabbi avahu verabbi chanina bar pappi verabbi yitzchak nappacha, vitev rabbi abba gabbayyhu. amar lehu: shappir tafsituha. amar lehu rabbi abba: mishshum deve nesia ninhu mechannefitu lehu? veha dun dayyayne kerabbi tarfon, veahdereh resh lakish ovada minnayyhu.

Yemar bar chashu hava massek beh zuze behahu gavra, shechev ushevak arba. amar leh lishlucheh: zil, tefasa nihali. azal tafsa. pegau beh rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua, amaru leh: at tofes levaal chov bemakom shechav laacherim. veamar rabbi yochanan: hattofes levaal chov bemakom shechav laacherim

a: Lo kana. tafsuha inhu. rav pappa meymallach malloche. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua memattach la beashla. mar amar: ana kanena la lechulla, umar amar: ana kanena la lechulla.
Pega behu rav pinchas bar amme, amar lehu: rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu vehu shetztzevurin umunnachin birshut harabbim! amar lehu: anan name mecharifuta denahara tefesna.
Ato lekammeh derava, amar lehu: kake chivvare, meshalleche gelime deinashe! hachi amar rav nachman: vehu shettefasah mechayyim.
Avimi bereh derabbi avahu havo masseki beh zuze be chozae, shadderinhu beyad chama bereh derabba bar avahu. azal parinhu. amar lehu: havu li shetara. amaru leh: sitrae ninhu.
Ata lekammeh derabbi avahu. amar leh: it lecha sahade difratinhu? amar leh: la. amar leh: miggo dicholin lomar "lo hayu devarim meolam", yecholin name lememar "sitrae ninhu".
Leinyan shallome shaliach may? amar rav ashe: chazenan, i amar leh "shekol shetara vehav zuze" — meshallem. "hav zuze ushekol shetara" — la meshallem.
Vela hi, ben kach uven kach meshallem. deamar leh: "letakkone shaddartaycha vela leauote".

Hahi itteta dahavo mippakdi gabba meluga dishtare. ato yorshim ka tavi leh minna. amara lehu: mechayyim tefesna lehu. atay lekammeh derav nachman, amar la: it lich sahade detavuha minnich mechayyim vela yehavyt nihaleh? amra leh: la. im ken, have tefisa dilachar mita, utefisa dilachar mita — lo kelum hi.
Hahi itteta deichayyayva shevua be dina derava. amara leh bat rav chisda: yadana bah dachashuda ashshevua. afcha rava lishvua ashshekkenegdah.

Zimnin havu yatvi kammeh rav pappa verav adda bar matna, ayyto hahu shetara gabbeh. amar leh rav pappa: yadana beh dishtara peria hu. amar leh: ikka inish acharina bahadeh demar? amar leh: la. amar leh: af al gav deikka mar, ed echad lav kelum hu.
Amar leh rav adda bar matna: velo yehe rav pappa kevat rav chisda? bat rav chisda kim li begavvav, mar la kim li begavvevy.
Amar rav pappa: hasheta deamar mar "kim li begavvevy" milleta hi, kegon abba mar beri dekim li begavvevy, karana shetara appummeh.
Karana salka datach?! ella: marana shetara appummeh.

Hahi itteta deichayyayva shevua be dina derav bivi bar abbaye. amar lehu hahu baal din: tete vetishteva bemata, efshar demikkasfa umodya. amara lehu: ketuvu li zachvota, dechi mishtevana yahavi li. amar lehu rav bivi bar abbaye: kitvu la.
Amar rav pappe: mishshum deatetu mimmulae amritu mille muleyata?!
Ha amar rava: hay ashsharta dedayyayne demikkatva mikkamme denachvo sahade achatimut yedayyhu — pesula. alma michze keshikra, hachi name michze keshikra.

Veleta, midderav nachman. deamar rav nachman, omer haya rabbi meir: afillu metzao beashpa vachatamo unetano lah — kasher. vaafillu rabbanan la peligi aleh derabbi meir ella begitte nashim, devaenan ketiva lishmah, aval bishar shetarot modu leh.
Deamar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: shetar shellava bo uferao — eno chozer velove bo. shekkevar nimchal shibudo: tama denimchal shibudo, aval lemichze
b: Keshikra la chayyshinan.

Hahu gavra deafked shav marganyata detzayyri bisdina be rabbi meyasha bar bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi. shechev rabbi meyasha vela pakked. ato lekammeh derabbi amme, amar lehu: chada, deyadana beh berabbi meyasha bar bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi dela amid. veod, ha ka yahev simana.
Vela amaran ella dela regil deayel venafek lehatam. aval ragil deayel venafek lehatam, ema inish acharina afked veihu michza chaza.

Hahu gavra deafked kasa dechaspa be chasa. shachev chasa, vela pakked. ato lekammeh derav nachman amar lehu: yadana beh bechasa dela amid. veod, ha ka yahev simana. vela amaran ella dela regil deayel venafek lehatam, aval regil deayel venafek lehatam, emar inish acharina afked veihu michza chaza.

Hahu deafked metachsa be rav dimi achu derav safra, shachev rav dimi vela pakked. ata lekammeh derabbi abba, amar lehu: chada, deyadana beh berav dimi dela amid. veod, ha ka yahev simana. vela amaran ella dela regil deayel venafek lehatam, aval regil deayel venafek lehatam, ema inish acharina afked veihu michza chaza.
Hahu daamar lehu: nichsayy letoviyya. shachev, ata toviyya. amar rabbi yochanan: hare ba toviyya.

Amar "toviyya" vaata rav toviyya — letoviyya amar, lerav toviyya la amar. vei inish degis beh, ha gis beh. ato shene toviyya, shachen vetalmid chacham — talmid chacham kodem. karov vetalmid chacham — talmid chacham kodem.
Ibbaya lehu: shachen vekarov may? ta shema: "tov shachen karov meach rachok". shenehem kerovim, ushenehem shechenim, ushenehem chachamim? shuda dedayyayne.

Amar leh rava livreh derav chiyyay bar avin: ta ema lach milleta meallayvta dahava amar avuch. ha deamar shemuel hammocher shetar chov lachavero vechazar umechalo — machul, vaafillu yoresh mochel — mode shemuel bemachneset shetar chov levalah, vechazra umechalatto — sheeno machul, mippene sheyyado keyadah.
Karivteh derav nachman zabbenta lichtubbeta betovat hanaa — iggarasha ushechiva. ato ka tavi la livratta. amar lehu rav nachman: lekka delaysseva (lah) etza?!

a: Tezil vetaychala lichtubbeta deimma legabbe avu, veterta minneh. shemaa azala achelta.
Amar rav nachman: asinu atzmenu keorche haddayyaynin. meikkara may sevar, ulevassof may sevar? meikkara sevar: "umibbesarcha lo titallam", ulevassof savar: adam chashuv shane.

Gufa, amar shemuel: hammocher shetar chov lachavero, vechazar umechalo — machul, vaafillu yoresh mochel. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: vei pikkeach hu, mekarkesh leh zuze, vechatev leh shetara bishmeh.
Amar ammemar: man dedaen dina digrame — magbe beh deme shetara mealleya. man dela daen dina degarme, magbe beh deme neyayra bealma.
Hava ovada vechafyeh rafram lerav ashe, veagbi beh ki cheshura letzalme.

Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav chama: hay man deikka aleh ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov, veit leh ara veit leh zuze — levaal chov mesallekinan leh bezuze, leishsha mesallekinan la beara, hay ki dineh vehay ki dineh.
Vei la ikka ella chad ara vela chazya ella lechad — levaal chov yahavinan leh, leishsha la yahavinan la. may tama — yoter mimma shehaish rotze lissa, ishsha rotza lehinnase.

Amar leh rav pappa lerav chama: vadday deamritu mishshemeh derava, hay man demasseki beh zuze, veit leh ara, vaata baal chov veka tava minneh, veamar leh: "zil shekol meara", amrinan leh: "zil zabben at, veayyti hav leh"? amar leh: la.
Ema li gufa deovada hechi hava. amar leh: tole meotav begoy hava, hu asa shello kahogen — lefichach asu bo shello kahogen.

Amar leh rav kahana lerav pappa: ledidach deamrat periat baal chov mitzva, amar: "la nicha li deebed mitzva", may? amar leh, tenena: bamme devarim amurim — bemitzvat lo taase, aval bemitzvat ase, kegon sheomrin lo ase sukka veeno ose, lulav veeno ose —
b: Makkin oto ad shettetze nafsho.
Bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: "hare ze gittech, velo titgarshi bo ella leachar sheloshim yom", vehalcha vehinnichattu betzidde reshut harabbim, mahu?
Amar leh: enah megoreshet, midderav ushemuel. derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu, vehu shetztzevurin umunnachin birshut harabbim, vetzidde reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim damu.

Adderabba, megoreshet, midderav nachman. deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: haomer lachavero: "meshoch para zo, velo tihye kenuya lach ad leachar sheloshim yom" — kana, vaafillu omedet baagam. may lav: hayeynu agam, vehayeynu tzidde reshut harabbim? la, agam lechud vetzidde reshut harabbim lechud.

Ikka deamri, amar leh: megoreshet, midderav nachman. vetzidde reshut harabbim kaagam dame. adderabba: enah megoreshet, midderav ushemuel. may lav: hayeynu "reshut harabbim", vehayeynu "tzidde reshut harabbim". la, reshut harabbim lechod, vetzidde reshut harabbim lechod.
Mishna hammoshiv et ishto chenvonit, o shemminnah appotroppeya — hare ze mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze. rabbi eliezer omer: afillu al pilkah veal issatah.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: rabbi eliezer al yede gilgul kaamar — o lechattechilla kaamar?
Ta shema, amru lo lerabbi eliezer: en adam dar im nachash bichfifa. i amrat bishlama lechattechilla — shappir. ella i amrat al yede gilgul, may nafka la minna?
Deamra leh: kevan dekadayykat batray kulle hay — la matzyana deedur bahadach.

Ta shema: hare shello patar et ishto min hanneder umin hashshevua, vehoshivah chenvonit, o shemminah appotroppeya — hare ze mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze. lo hoshivah chenvonit, velo minnah appotroppeya — eno yachol lehashebiah.

Rabbi eliezer omer: af al pi shello hoshivah chenvonit, velo minnah appotroppeya — hare ze mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze, sheen lecha ishsha shello naaset appotroppeya shaa achat bechayye balah al pilkah veal issatah. amru lo: en adam dar im nachash bichfifa. shema minnah lechattechilla shema minnah.
Mishna katav lah "neder ushevua en li alayich" — en yachol lehashebiah, aval mashbia hu et yorsheha, veet habbaim birshutah.

"Neder ushevua en li alayich veal yorshayich veal habbaim berishshutecha" — eno yachol lehashebiah, lo hi, velo yorsheha, velo et habbaim birshutah. aval yorshav mashbiin otah veet yorsheha, veet habbaim birshutah.

"Neder ushevua en li, velo leyorshay, velo labbaim birshuti alayich, veal yorshayich, veal habbaim birshutich" — eno yachol lehashebiah, lo hu velo yorshav velo habbaim birshuto, lo otah velo yorsheha, velo habbaim birshutah.

Halcha mikkever balah levet aviha, o shechazra levet chamiha velo naaset appotroppeya — en hayyorshin mashbiin otah. veim naaset appotroppeya — hayyorshin mashbiin otah al heatid lavo, veen mashbiin otah al ma sheavar.
Gemara shevua may avidte? amar rav yehuda amar rav:
